paper.title: Aspire: Can Models Self-Evolve from Vague Goals?
paper.abstract: Many important forms of human learning begin with a vague goal, such as "become a better physicist" or "improve at research." Learners must interpret the goal, identify capability gaps, decide how to learn, and determine whether they have actually improved. In contrast, existing work on LLM self-evolution typically begins with tasks and evaluation metrics specified by humans, reducing self-evolution to optimizing an explicit objective rather than deciding what and how to learn. We introduce ASPI

summary.core_problem: 现有的 LLM 自我进化研究通常依赖人类指定的明确任务和评估指标，而人类学习往往从模糊目标开始。本文旨在评估模型在仅给定模糊目标（如“提升研究能力”）时，能否自主决定学习内容、方法并评估进展。
summary.importance: 提出了首个针对模糊目标驱动的自我进化基准测试 ASPIRE，将自我进化从优化明确目标转变为自主决策学习过程，为评估更高级别的自主学习能力提供了工具。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 ASPIRE 基准，仅提供自然语言描述的能力目标，隐藏下游评估任务。Agent 必须自主选择数据和更新方法、构建训练和验证信号，并决定何时进行评估。该基准支持模型权重和 agent-harness 的进化，并在统一的交互环境中进行评估。
summary.experiments: 在包含 520 个项目的隐藏专家级测试集上评估了进化后的系统，涵盖了多种能力维度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM self-evolution research typically relies on human-specified explicit tasks and evaluation metrics, whereas human learning often begins with vague goals. This paper aims to evaluate whether models can autonomously decide what and how to learn, and assess their progress, when given only vague goals (e.g., 'improve at research').
summary_en.importance: Introduces ASPIRE, the first benchmark for vague-goal-driven self-evolution, shifting self-evolution from optimizing explicit objectives to autonomous decision-making in the learning process, providing a tool for evaluating higher-level autonomous learning capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructs the ASPIRE benchmark, providing only natural-language capability goals while hiding downstream evaluation tasks. The agent must autonomously choose data and update methods, construct training and validation signals, and decide when to evaluate. The benchmark supports both model-weight and agent-harness evolution in a unified interactive environment.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates the evolved systems on a hidden, expert-authored set of 520 items spanning various capability dimensions.

recommendation.zh: 将自我进化的评估从明确任务推向模糊目标，更贴近 AGI 的自主学习设定，值得关注其评测协议和任务设计。
recommendation.en: Pushes the evaluation of self-evolution from explicit tasks to vague goals, closer to the autonomous learning setting of AGI; worth noting its evaluation protocol and task design.

paper.title: EvoUndo: Recoverability-Constrained Self-Evolution for LLM Agent Harnesses
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly modify their own prompts, tools, middleware, resources, and execution harnesses at runtime. Such self-evolution can improve capability, but a successful mutation may leave persistent effects that cannot be safely reversed in states different from the one in which it was created. We introduce EvoUndo, a framework for representing, synthesizing, diagnosing, and independently verifying recoverability of model-generated self-modifications across counterfactual states. Across

summary.core_problem: 当 LLM Agent 在运行时修改自身的 prompt、工具或执行环境（自我进化）时，如何确保这些修改在不同状态下是安全可逆的？
summary.importance: 指出了 Agent 自我进化带来的一个关键风险：状态依赖的不可逆性。提出了一个框架来诊断和验证这种可恢复性，属于 Agent 安全和鲁棒性研究。
summary.technical_approach: 引入 EvoUndo 框架，用于表示、合成、诊断和独立验证模型生成的自我修改在反事实状态下的可恢复性。通过扩展恢复演算（recovery calculus）来提高恢复的成功率。
summary.experiments: 在 600 个未见过的 one-shot 自我进化任务中，识别出 197 个提升能力但无法通过可恢复性验证的突变。传统的修复策略恢复率为 0/197，而扩展的恢复演算将经验 oracle 恢复率提高到 191/197。

summary_en.core_problem: When LLM agents modify their own prompts, tools, or execution environments at runtime (self-evolution), how can we ensure these modifications are safely reversible across different states?
summary_en.importance: Highlights a critical risk of agent self-evolution: state-dependent irreversibility. Proposes a framework to diagnose and verify this recoverability, contributing to agent safety and robustness research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the EvoUndo framework to represent, synthesize, diagnose, and independently verify the recoverability of model-generated self-modifications across counterfactual states. Improves recovery success rates by extending the recovery calculus.
summary_en.experiments: Across 600 unseen one-shot self-evolution tasks, identified 197 capability-improving mutations that fail recoverability verification. Conventional repair strategies recovered 0/197, while the extended recovery calculus increased empirical oracle recovery to 191/197.

recommendation.zh: 关注 Agent 自我修改（self-evolution）带来的状态不可逆问题，提出了一个形式化的恢复验证框架，对研究复杂 Agent 系统的鲁棒性有启发。
recommendation.en: Focuses on the state irreversibility problem caused by agent self-evolution, proposing a formalized recovery verification framework. Inspiring for research on the robustness of complex agent systems.

paper.title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Self-evolving LLM coding agents write their own tools by imitating retrieved skills from shared skill libraries. We identify a vulnerability in this loop: during authoring, a retrieved malicious skill can become the template for a new skill that preserves the payload. We call this self-poisoning: the agent authors, stores, and runs the resulting malicious skill. We exploit it through EvoMal, an attack that amplifies self-poisoning by wrapping an interchangeable payload in a banner, a set of beni

summary.core_problem: 自进化 coding agent 会从共享 skill library 检索并模仿技能写新工具，这一闭环可能被恶意技能诱导产生自我投毒。
summary.importance: 贡献是 coding agent 安全中的新攻击面：恶意技能即使不被直接调用，也能作为模板被模仿、复制、入库并继续传播；对训练 agentic coding model 和构建工具库治理有实际警示。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EvoMal 攻击，把可替换 payload 包在一组看似无害的结构元素 banner 中，使 agent 在 authoring 新 skill 时复现其中代码。论文定义 Agent Self-Poisoning Rate，衡量任务中新增恶意 skill 的比例。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、任务集和成功率数值；声称攻击者只需向 skill library 植入恶意技能，无需触发执行，随后 agent 会创作并运行带 payload 的新技能，且副本可重新进入库形成持久传播。

summary_en.core_problem: Self-evolving coding agents retrieve and imitate skills from shared libraries to write new tools, creating a loop that can be exploited for self-poisoning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a new attack surface for coding agents: a malicious skill can be copied as a template even when it is not directly invoked, then stored, executed, and propagated. This matters for training agentic coding models and governing shared tool libraries.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoMal wraps an interchangeable payload inside a benign-looking structural banner that induces the agent to reproduce the enclosed code when authoring new skills. The paper defines Agent Self-Poisoning Rate as the fraction of tasks that add newly authored malicious skills.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide exact models, task sets, or attack success rates. It claims the attacker only needs to plant malicious skills in the library; the agent can then author and execute new payload-carrying skills, and copies can re-enter the library to persist after the original planted skills are removed.

recommendation.zh: 读威胁模型和 ASPR 定义即可；它不是 pretrain 论文，但会影响 coding agent 数据闭环设计。
recommendation.en: Read the threat model and ASPR definition; not a pretraining paper, but it matters for coding-agent data-loop design.

paper.title: JIT-Agent: Scaling Harness Intelligence via Just-in-Time Harness Evolution
paper.abstract: Agent capability is not determined by the model alone. The agent harness, encompassing memory management, planning strategy, action protocol, and tool/skill orchestration, can dominate the contribution of the underlying foundation model. Yet harness design remains manual, task-specific, and fundamentally unscalable. We present JIT-Agent, a harness intelligence model trained to synthesize task-adaptive agent harnesses on the fly for arbitrary off-the-shelf agentic LLMs. We formalize the agent har

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文关注 agent 能力不只由底座模型决定，还强烈依赖 harness，即记忆、规划、动作协议、工具和技能编排。它要解决的问题是：能否训练一个元模型，在看到具体任务时即时生成可执行的 task-specific harness，而不是提前人工设计或离线搜索一个通用 harness。
summary.importance: 这不是 LLM 预训练方法论文，但对通用 agent 研究有一定参考意义。它把 harness 作为可生成、可修复、可演化的程序化对象，并提出专门训练一个 harness intelligence model。对基座研究员的启发主要在两个层面：一是模型能力评估不能只看权重，还要控制执行外壳；二是 agent post-training 数据可以来自 harness 生成、失败修复和执行反馈，而不只是轨迹模仿。
summary.technical_approach: JIT-Agent 将 agent harness 约束为四个模块：memory、planning、action、capability orchestration。作者构建 HarnessFactory，把不同 scaffold 统一到同一接口，使模型生成的是结构化、可执行模块，而不是任意 agent 程序。训练分三阶段：Stage I 用 teacher 生成的协议合规样例学习任务条件化定制；Stage II 把编译错误、接口不匹配、运行时失败转成 bounded repair trajectories，训练模型做可靠修复；Stage III 使用 Evolutionary Group-Decoupled Policy Optimization，让模型提出能超过当前 archive frontier 的 harness，并对 reward、latency、cost 分别归一化。推理时，JIT-Agent 接收任务、协议、工具/技能注册表和检索到的历史 harness，生成一个外壳来驱动任意 off-the-shelf agentic LLM。
summary.experiments: 给定全文片段说明作者训练了 JIT-Agent-27B，并声称它能提升高效 backbone，也能结合更强 backbone；但片段未提供 benchmark 名称、任务数量、胜率、成本、延迟或消融数字。应重点验证三组实验：即时生成 harness 是否优于固定 AOT harness；repair stage 是否显著降低不可执行率；Evo-GDPO 是否在 reward、latency、cost 之间带来稳定收益，而不是只通过更复杂外壳增加调用成本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 harness 四模块协议、HarnessFactory 的接口定义、三阶段训练数据构造，以及 Evo-GDPO 的目标函数。实验部分若可获得，先看不同 backbone 下的增益和成本，再看不可执行 harness 的修复率，最后看 archive evolution 的消融。需要保持警惕的是任务分布是否足够多样，生成 harness 是否真的泛化到新工具和新模型，以及性能提升是否来自更多调用预算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that agent capability is determined by the model-harness pair, not by the foundation model alone. It asks whether a trained meta-agent can generate an executable, task-specific harness at inference time, instead of relying on manually designed or ahead-of-time optimized scaffolds.
summary_en.importance: This is not a base pretraining paper, but it is relevant to general agent methodology. The main contribution is to treat the agent harness as a machine-generatable artifact that can be customized, repaired, and evolved from feedback. For foundation-model researchers, the useful implication is that agent evaluation and post-training data quality depend heavily on the execution harness; trajectories are not independent of memory design, planning protocol, tool exposure, and recovery logic.
summary_en.technical_approach: JIT-Agent represents a harness as a four-module protocol covering memory, planning, action, and capability orchestration. HarnessFactory provides a shared interface and a library of representative scaffolds, so the generator emits structured executable modules rather than unconstrained programs. Training has three stages. Stage I teaches task-conditioned harness customization from teacher-generated, protocol-compliant examples. Stage II turns compiler errors, interface mismatches, and runtime failures into bounded repair trajectories. Stage III introduces Evolutionary Group-Decoupled Policy Optimization, where the model learns to propose harnesses that improve over an archive frontier while normalizing reward, latency, and cost separately. At inference time, the generated harness wraps an arbitrary off-the-shelf agentic LLM.
summary_en.experiments: The provided excerpt reports the training of JIT-Agent-27B and claims improved execution when paired with both efficient and stronger backbones. It does not provide the full benchmark suite, task counts, win rates, latency, cost, or ablation numbers. The critical experiments to inspect are comparisons against fixed ahead-of-time harnesses, the failure-rate reduction from the repair stage, and the contribution of Evo-GDPO under controlled inference budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is appropriate. Read the four-module harness protocol, the HarnessFactory abstraction, the data construction for the three training stages, and the Evo-GDPO objective. In the experiments, first check gains across different backbone models, then inspect repair success rates and cost-normalized performance. The main risks to evaluate are distribution narrowness, hidden extra tool-call budget, and whether generated harnesses generalize to new tools, new task families, and different agentic LLMs.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain 方法，但会改你看 agent 结果的口径：先看 harness ablation 再看底模排名，重点读 protocol 设计和 archive self-evolution 是否真能跨任务复用。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining directly, but it should change how you read agent results: inspect harness ablations before trusting base-model rankings, especially the protocol design and whether archive-driven self-evolution really transfers.

paper.title: Self-Evolving Code-with-Image Reasoning
paper.abstract: Multimodal models increasingly reach for tools when solving visual tasks (crop, zoom, rotate, brighten), a paradigm known as thinking-with-images. The central challenge is one of perception: tools mostly serve to expose visual evidence, reasoning over that evidence stays in language, and most targets are ones a human could in principle determine by inspection. Some visual questions, however, are not bottlenecked by perception: recovering their answers requires executing a multi-step visual algor

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态视觉推理中模型能正确描述视觉算法、却无法在像素层面执行多步视觉计算的感知-执行脱节问题。
summary.importance: 属于多模态推理范式的方法创新，提出将代码执行作为视觉推理载体并引入自进化训练循环，对VLM工具调用设计有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Code-with-Image范式：要求模型仅借助Python解释器编写可执行视觉算法代码完成任务，将推理过程从语言描述转化为程序执行；进一步引入自进化机制，让模型在无额外标注下自我迭代优化算法选择与代码实现。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、训练数据量、对比基线及量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the perception-execution gap in multimodal visual reasoning, where models can correctly describe visual algorithms but fail to execute multi-step pixel-level visual computations.
summary_en.importance: A methodological innovation in multimodal reasoning paradigms; proposes code execution as the carrier of visual reasoning and introduces a self-evolving training loop, offering reference for VLM tool-use design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Code-with-Image paradigm: requires models to write executable visual algorithm code using only a Python interpreter to solve tasks, shifting reasoning from language description to program execution; further adds a self-evolution mechanism where the model iteratively improves algorithm selection and code implementation without extra annotations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific model sizes, training data volume, comparison baselines, or quantitative performance gains.

recommendation.zh: 多模态工具调用的小范式尝试，核心是用代码执行替代语言推理，看摘要和方法框架即可，无需深挖。
recommendation.en: A small paradigm attempt for multimodal tool use, centered on replacing language reasoning with code execution; read the abstract and method framework only, no deep dive needed.

paper.title: Beyond the Capability Boundary: Zeroth-Order Optimization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Self-evolving methods improve the capabilities of LLM agents by sampling trajectories from the underlying LLMs and learning from these trajectories. However, these methods struggle to learn beyond the inherent capability boundary of the agents, since the agents cannot sample correct trajectories on difficult examples for further improvements. In this paper, we propose a zeroth-order self-evolution framework that enables agents to learn beyond their capability boundary by perturbing LLM parameter

summary.core_problem: 现有自演化LLM Agent依赖自身采样的成功轨迹做迭代SFT/RL更新，但在超出基座模型原生能力边界的难例上无法生成正确轨迹，导致性能存在硬上限；直接将零阶优化用于Agent训练则面临轨迹采样成本过高、最终答案奖励稀疏噪声大的落地障碍。
summary.importance: 属于后训练与Agent训练的交叉方向，提出的无需轨迹标注、通过零阶扰动LoRA探索难例成功轨迹的思路，为无强教师模型做轨迹蒸馏场景下的Agent能力迭代提供了可行路径，其针对零阶梯度估计的效率优化设计对黑盒环境下的模型适配也有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 框架实现了闭环零阶自演化流程：1）为每个难例挂载实例专属LoRA模块，随机扰动LoRA参数后分别在原始参数、扰动参数下运行Agent，用损失差值估计梯度更新LoRA，整个过程仅需最终答案监督，不需要任何中间轨迹标注；2）并行扰动推理机制：所有扰动分支共享同一次主干前向计算，仅需极小额外开销即可并行评估多个LoRA扰动的输出结果；3）自适应查询缓存：缓存近期工具调用结果，根据查询类型选择精确匹配或相似度匹配复用结果，减少重复工具调用开销；4）答案困惑度代理损失：将生成轨迹条件下参考答案的负对数似然作为过程级替代信号，替代稀疏的二元对错奖励，提升零阶优化稳定性。经该流程优化得到的LoRA可生成难例上的成功轨迹，这些轨迹随后加入全局SFT数据集，形成完整的能力迭代闭环。
summary.experiments: 在多个深度研究类Agent基准上，该方法性能优于依赖GPT等强模型生成标注轨迹的自演化基线；难例上的成功轨迹采样率显著高于原始基座模型，验证了突破原生能力边界的效果；消融实验分别验证了并行推理、缓存机制、答案困惑度损失对训练效率、优化稳定性的独立贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注零阶自演化的闭环逻辑、两项效率优化与代理损失的设计、以及难例轨迹采样率的分析部分，可跳过零阶优化的深层理论推导；核心关注点是无需过程监督探索难例成功轨迹的设计思路，预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing self-evolving LLM agents rely on successful trajectories sampled by the model itself for iterative SFT/RL updates, but cannot generate correct trajectories on hard examples beyond the base model's inherent capability boundary, creating a hard performance ceiling. Direct application of zeroth-order optimization to agent training also faces prohibitive trajectory sampling costs and noisy, sparse final-answer rewards that prevent stable convergence.
summary_en.importance: This work sits at the intersection of post-training and agent research. The proposed paradigm of using zeroth-order LoRA perturbation to explore successful trajectories without trajectory annotations provides a viable path for agent capability iteration when no stronger teacher model is available for trajectory distillation. Its efficiency optimizations for zeroth-order gradient estimation also offer reference value for model adaptation in black-box environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework implements a closed-loop zeroth-order self-evolution pipeline: 1) Instance-specific LoRA modules are attached for each hard example. LoRA parameters are randomly perturbed, the agent is run under both original and perturbed parameters, and loss differences are used to estimate gradients for LoRA updates. The entire process only requires final answer supervision, with no intermediate trajectory annotation needed. 2) Parallel perturbation inference: All perturbation branches share the same backbone forward pass, allowing parallel evaluation of multiple LoRA perturbations with minimal extra compute overhead. 3) Adaptive lookup cache: Recent tool call results are cached, with exact or similarity-based reuse selected according to query type to reduce redundant tool invocations. 4) Answer perplexity surrogate loss: The negative log-likelihood of the reference answer conditioned on the generated trajectory is used as a process-level proxy signal, replacing sparse binary correctness rewards to stabilize zeroth-order optimization. LoRAs optimized via this pipeline can generate successful trajectories on hard examples, which are then added to the global SFT dataset to form a complete capability iteration loop.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple deep research agent benchmarks, the method outperforms strong self-evolution baselines that rely on trajectory annotations from stronger models such as GPT-4. The successful trajectory sampling rate on hard examples is significantly higher than the base model, confirming the ability to push performance beyond the original capability boundary. Ablations validate the individual contributions of parallel inference, caching, and the answer perplexity loss to training efficiency and optimization stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the closed-loop design of zeroth-order self-evolution, the two efficiency optimizations, the surrogate loss design, and the analysis of successful trajectory sampling rates on hard examples. Skip deep theoretical derivations of zeroth-order optimization. Focus on the core idea of exploring successful trajectories for hard examples without process supervision. Estimated reading time: 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 §method 和实验消融；若难例上真能低方差估梯度，这会改变 self-training 必须先采到好轨迹的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the hard-case gradient estimate is low-variance, it weakens the prior that self-training needs good trajectories first.

paper.title: Safe Evolution with Circuit Anchors
paper.abstract: In biological evolution, unconstrained mutation can lead to catastrophic outcomes: organisms may evolve enhanced capabilities while losing essential functions for survival. Nature's solution is \textit{developmental constraints}, where core regulatory genes remain anchored while peripheral genes adapt freely. We observe that current self-evolution algorithms for large language models lack analogous constraints. They optimize purely for capability, implicitly assuming safety will be preserved. Ou

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 自进化或自我改写过程中只追求能力提升、却可能破坏安全行为的问题。
summary.importance: 价值主要在两个接口：一是 mechanistic interpretability 是否能找到可因果干预的“安全电路”，二是这些局部特征能否作为后训练/自进化的约束。对预训练研究员不是主线，但对理解能力-安全耦合、以及 feature-level regularization 有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Circuit-Anchored Evolution（CAE）。作者先用机制可解释性识别一个占模型特征不到 2% 的 safety circuit，声称其因果介导安全行为；随后在 self-evolution 过程中对该电路施加锚定约束，让外围能力相关特征继续适配，而核心安全特征保持稳定，以避免 capability gain 伴随 safety collapse。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调一个关键现象：现有 self-evolution 算法会让模型“misevolve”为更强但更危险的系统；CAE 在保持能力增长的同时维持安全行为。摘要未给出模型规模、任务集、具体安全指标和对照算法，因此当前更像概念验证，需看正文确认电路识别是否稳健、因果证据是否充分。
summary.authors_note: 香港中文大学与 IQuest Research。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the problem that LLM self-evolution can optimize for capability while silently degrading safety behavior.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at two interfaces: whether mechanistic interpretability can identify causally actionable 'safety circuits', and whether such local features can serve as constraints during model evolution. This is not core pretraining work, but it is relevant to capability-safety coupling and feature-level regularization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Circuit-Anchored Evolution (CAE). It first uses mechanistic interpretability to identify a safety circuit, claimed to be less than 2% of model features and causally responsible for safety behavior. During self-evolution, this circuit is anchored while other features remain adaptable, aiming to preserve safety while allowing capability gains.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract highlights a central empirical claim: existing self-evolution methods can produce models that are more capable yet more dangerous, whereas CAE preserves safety while improving capability. The abstract does not provide model sizes, task suites, safety metrics, or baseline details, so this currently reads as a proof-of-concept pending closer inspection of the causal evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: From the Chinese University of Hong Kong and IQuest Research.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 feature-level 约束能否替代部分对齐数据，这篇可看；但“<2% 特征就是安全电路”这个说法很重，先审因果干预实验再决定信不信。
recommendation.en: Read it if you care whether feature-level constraints can substitute for some alignment data, but the '<2% features define safety' claim is strong—check the causal intervention section before buying it.

paper.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach and pivot when measurements reveal failure, hidden constraints, or a misspecified objective. We present Argus, a persistent, self-evolving runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer execute bounded missions over durable project state. Argus separates stable user intent from operational objectives, constraints, and verification criteria, and admits memories, skills, proce

summary.core_problem: 长时程 agent 执行中，初始目标经常是不完备甚至错误的，agent 必须能够在不偏离用户真实意图的前提下修订操作目标；但允许修订又会引入目标漂移——失败和合理 pivot 在外部观测上不可区分。现有系统要么固定目标禁止 pivot，要么在长轨迹上丢失证据、让执行者自行验收，导致安全性与连续性同时失效。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对 post-train 和 agent runtime 设计有参考价值：它把“目标不是固定 supervison，而是带证据、带权限、带记录的演化合同”这个视角讲清楚了，对理解长程推理中模型需要什么样的状态表示、验证器接口、以及 self-evolution 是否可在不更新参数的情况下通过外部状态实现，提供了一个清晰的工程抽象。
summary.technical_approach: Argus 把长任务拆成 bounded missions 序列，围绕 durable project state 运行。四类角色分权：Manager 锚定意图与 campaign 状态，Planner 选下一个工作单元，Engineer 执行和评估，Reviewer 独立验收；低风险任务可走记录式 self-review。三个平面（control / execution / records）把调度、执行、记录分开。工作合同显式表示为 K_t=(ι, o_t, c_t, v_t)，其中 ι 是不变的用户意图，o_t 是当前操作目标，c_t 是约束，v_t 是验证准则。目标、约束或验证准则的更新必须由证据触发、通过对应权限角色 admission、并写入持久记录；只有能降低未来任务风险或成本的更新才被视为 compounding。论文将这一机制称为 verification-gated fixed-model runtime self-evolution：模型参数不变，但后续 mission 从演化过的搜索策略、技能、verifier、路由决策开始，而非仅从更长的 transcript 开始。
summary.experiments: 评估分为三部分：(1) 七个 benchmark arena，覆盖软件修复、GPU kernel、语言模型训练、训练速度、研究助理任务、数学数据合成；报告 SWE-Bench Pro 结果，AARRI-Bench 76.8%，数学数据合成 gap 28.0，均高于文中引用的参考值。(2) 731 个 SWE-Bench Pro 任务的长程轨迹分析，观察 Skill/Wiki 演化、verifier recovery、Reviewer 干预、成熟阶段运行成本变化。(3) 纵向部署观察，记录 41 个 research artifacts across six programs，但多数为内部系统验证案例，以定性使用反馈为主，缺少公开、对照的零干预率统计。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看第 3 节关于 K_t 合同更新规则、第 6 节关于 self-evolution 的纵向观察，以及 introduction 中对 pivot vs drift 的区分。不必细抠 benchmark 数字，因为评估以部署观察和内部案例为主，对照不严格。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon agent execution, the initial objective is often underspecified or wrong, so the agent must be able to revise operational objectives without silently abandoning the user’s standing intent. But allowing revision introduces goal drift: principled pivots and outright failure are externally indistinguishable. Existing systems either fix the objective and forbid pivots, or lose evidence on long transcripts and let the executor certify its own completion, breaking both safety and continuity.
summary_en.importance: Direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but the paper is useful for post-training and agent-runtime design. It articulates a clean abstraction in which the objective is not a fixed supervision target but an evolving contract with evidence, authority, and records. That framing is helpful for thinking about what state representations, verifier interfaces, and forms of self-improvement long-horizon systems need, including fixed-model self-evolution mediated by external state rather than parameter updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: Argus structures a long campaign as a sequence of bounded missions over a durable project state. Four model-driven roles split authority: a Manager anchors intent and campaign state, a Planner selects the next unit of work, an Engineer implements and evaluates it, and a Reviewer independently inspects artifacts before issuing completion verdicts; low-risk tasks may use recorded Engineer self-review. These roles operate across three planes—control, execution, and records—so scheduling, execution, and bookkeeping stay separable. The working contract is written explicitly as K_t=(ι, o_t, c_t, v_t), where ι is the invariant user intent, o_t the current operational objective, c_t the constraints, and v_t the verification criteria. Material updates to the objective, constraints, or verifier require evidence, admission by the authorized role, and durable logging; an accepted update counts as compounding only when it reduces future task risk or cost. The mechanism is called verification-gated fixed-model runtime self-evolution: model parameters stay fixed, but later missions start from an evolved search policy with retained routes, measurements, verdicts, reusable skills, verifiers, and routing decisions rather than merely a longer transcript.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation is organized in three parts. First, seven benchmark arenas cover software repair, GPU kernels, language-model training, training speed, research-assistant tasks, and mathematical data synthesis; reported numbers include SWE-Bench Pro results, 76.8% on AARRI-Bench, and a 28.0 gap on mathematical-data synthesis, all above referenced baselines. Second, a 731-task SWE-Bench Pro trajectory supports longitudinal analyses of Skill/Wiki evolution, verifier recovery, Reviewer intervention, and mature-stage operating cost. Third, deployment evidence includes 41 research artifacts across six programs, but many cases are internal system-verification episodes and are reported qualitatively; no controlled zero-touch rate is provided for the public traces.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 3 for the K_t contract-update formalism, Section 6 for the longitudinal self-evolution observations, and the introduction’s framing of pivot versus drift. Do not over-weight the benchmark numbers, since much of the evidence is observational and based on internal deployments rather than controlled comparisons. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 固定权重下仅靠运行时状态自进化就拿到SWE-Bench Pro 19点提升，token效率很高，值得关注其验证门控的设计细节
recommendation.en: A 19-point gain on SWE-Bench Pro via runtime state self-evolution without weight updates is highly token-efficient; the verification gating design is worth examining

paper.title: Rethinking Self-Evolution: A Constrained Exploration-Exploitation Process for Mitigating Skill Overfitting
paper.abstract: Enabling large language model (LLM) agents to accumulate and reuse experience from past interactions remains a central challenge in real-world applications. A promising solution is to treat skills as trainable states and optimize them in the same way as model parameters in neural network training. However, data-driven skill optimization is prone to overfitting to the limited trajectories collected from real environments. Overexploiting these trajectories overfits the current batch, while unconst

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在自我演化技能时容易对有限轨迹过拟合、同时又可能因无约束探索而退化的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent skill memory / self-evolution 方法，贡献在于把技能更新显式建模为受约束的探索-利用过程。它不是预训练方法，但对理解 inference-time adaptation 与经验复用的失败模式有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillBoost 三阶段框架：structured exploitation 先定位已观察失败对应的可编辑技能组件；prior-guided exploration 利用 LLM 先验生成多样修复候选；verified acceptance 只在候选通过验证时提交更新，以避免当前 batch 过拟合和旧任务回退。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有提供具体环境、任务数量、模型、baseline 或定量提升；只能确认实验目标是评估技能自我演化中的过拟合缓解和回退控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses skill overfitting in LLM agents that self-evolve from limited trajectories, while also avoiding regressions caused by unconstrained exploration.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent skill-memory and self-evolution method. Its useful contribution is framing skill updates as a constrained exploration-exploitation process. It is not a pretraining method, but it gives some signal about failure modes in inference-time adaptation and experience reuse.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillBoost uses three stages: structured exploitation localizes observed failures to editable skill components; prior-guided exploration uses the LLM's prior knowledge to propose diverse repair candidates; verified acceptance commits an update only if it passes verification, aiming to reduce both batch overfitting and regression on previous cases.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify environments, task counts, model choices, baselines, or quantitative gains. The experiments appear to target overfitting mitigation and regression control during skill self-evolution.

recommendation.zh: 看 constrained exploration-exploitation framing 就够；它像 agent 版小步验证更新，对基座训练只有间接信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the constrained exploration-exploitation framing; it is essentially cautious verified updating for agents, with only indirect relevance to base training.

paper.title: DREvo: Distilling Recalibrated Historical Experience for Harness Self-Evolution
paper.abstract: Harness plays a critical role in large language model agent performance, and building a high-performing harness requires substantial expert effort. Therefore, recent research has increasingly explored harness self-evolution, which iteratively proposes, evaluates, and improves harnesses using historical trial experience. However, accumulated historical experience does not always translate into stable search guidance, and performance often fluctuates substantially across evolution iterations, maki

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 执行 harness 自动演化中，历史试验经验不能稳定指导后续搜索的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 系统方法改进。它关注的不是模型权重训练，而是 agent harness 的自动搜索与迭代优化，对通用 agent 工程有一定参考，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DREvo，将历史演化经验重新校准后再蒸馏为可执行的搜索方向。核心想法是动态判断历史经验是否仍适用于当前 harness，并显式把有效经验转化为下一轮修改建议，而不是简单累积过去试验结果。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、LLM 规模、演化预算、baseline 或提升幅度。只能确认目标是降低有限预算下 harness self-evolution 的性能波动，并更稳定地发现高性能 harness。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unstable use of historical trial experience in self-evolving LLM agent harnesses.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-system method contribution rather than a pretraining contribution. It is relevant to general agent infrastructure, but only weakly connected to foundation-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: DREvo distills recalibrated historical experience into actionable search directions. The key move is to reassess whether past experience remains valid for the current harness and then convert valid experience into explicit guidance for the next evolution step.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify benchmarks, model sizes, baselines, budgets, or numerical gains. The stated goal is to reduce performance fluctuation and improve discovery of strong harnesses under limited evolution budgets.

recommendation.zh: 可看作 agent harness 搜索的工程改良；只扫方法图即可，别把它当成训练范式信号。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an engineering tweak for agent-harness search; skim the method diagram, but do not read it as a training-paradigm signal.

paper.title: Teaching LLMs to Self-Evolve: Cultivating Core Meta-Skills with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling through iterative self-evolution with environment feedback, as demonstrated by AlphaEvolve, shows remarkable performance gains. We hypothesize that the success of such evolution frameworks hinges on meta-skills, such as self-reflection with environment feedback, that enable effective multi-round refinement, yet are largely neglected by traditional post-training. To bridge this gap, we present MetaEvolve, a framework designed to develop these meta-skills via a data synthesis pip

summary.core_problem: 如何把“带环境反馈的多轮自我改进”（self-evolution）从纯推理时启发式，变成模型可学习、可泛化的能力：模型不仅要解出题，还要在看到上一轮方案与反馈后，稳定地产生“更好”的下一轮方案，并能从历史尝试中提炼可操作的改进方向。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练闭环的启发在于：把“相对改进”而非“绝对正确”作为训练信号，提供了一种更接近 test-time scaling（迭代搜索/反思/修补）的对齐方式。它把可验证环境（代码执行）产生的连续奖励用于训练“改进能力”，在一定程度上缓解了传统 RLHF/PRM 更偏向单轮完成任务、难以直接优化多轮演化策略的问题。对通用预训练的直接贡献有限（主要是后训练范式），但对如何构造可规模化的过程数据、如何定义 reward 以鼓励真实进步而非模板化自省，有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三块组成：
1) 进化轨迹数据合成：基于约 25k 道编程题，先为每题采样多份候选程序（文中示例为每题 10 个），再做“两阶段多样性过滤”，优先保留解法池足够多样的题目与解答对。多样性信号不仅看语义，还用程序表面结构代理（字符长度差、行数差等）来确保历史尝试之间存在可学习的差异；核心动机是：如果历史解都很像，模型学不到“哪些改动带来性能提升”。
2) Evolution-aware RL：训练时输入显式包含“当前解 + 性能反馈 + 历史尝试”的上下文，让模型输出下一轮改进版程序。奖励来自可验证执行：既包含正确性，也包含运行时间等连续信号，从而把“能跑”与“跑得更快”之间的梯度变成可优化目标。与常见 coding RL 只优化 pass@k/AC 不同，这里优化的是相对提升（improvement）与多轮策略。
3) 推理时演化搜索：训练目标与推理时流程对齐，推理阶段继续用多轮生成-执行-反馈的循环做搜索/改进。论文强调：很多自我演化系统（如 AlphaEvolve 类）在推理时做多轮，但模型本身没在这种分布下训练；MetaEvolve 试图用数据与 RL 把这种分布内化。
差异点：不是教模型“写更长的反思”，而是把反思/诊断是否有效交给环境奖励裁决；并且把“历史轨迹”作为一等公民进入训练样本，而不是单轮 prompt engineering。
summary.experiments:
论文报告覆盖 7 个编程基准的多轮改进评测，核心指标是“绝对平均改进率”（absolute average improvement rate）。相对最强基线：
- In-distribution：绝对平均改进率 +10.01%。
- Out-of-distribution：绝对平均改进率 +24.12%。
- AlgoTune（开放式算法优化，超出训练域）：相对改进 +46.91%。
此外做了“程序新颖性/结构多样性”分析，显示生成解更结构化多样（文中对应 Table 3），并用案例展示更像“针对性诊断→策略调整→结构性重写”的多轮行为，而不是重复试错（Figure 2）。
局限：从给出的全文片段看，奖励设计与训练细节（例如如何把 runtime 归一化、如何处理噪声/超时、是否做 per-problem baseline、RL 算法与 KL 约束等）对可复现性与可迁移性很关键，但需要在方法与附录里核对；另外“元技能可迁移到非代码域”的证据主要来自跨基准/开放式优化任务，离真正跨模态/跨领域仍有距离。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 1（整体训练/推理闭环）与 Figure 2（行为对比），把“训练分布对齐推理分布”的主线抓住。
- 重点看数据合成与多样性过滤的定义：它决定了模型到底学到“比较与改进”，还是学到“换皮重写”。关注两阶段过滤各自筛掉什么样的题。
- 重点看 reward 由执行信号构成的细节：正确性与性能如何组合、如何避免 reward hacking（例如投机取巧的微基准优化）。
- 实验部分优先看 OOD 与 AlgoTune（Table 2/4），再回头看消融：是否去掉历史轨迹、去掉多样性过滤、只用 correctness reward、只做 SFT 不做 RL 等，哪些组件真正贡献改进率。

summary_en.core_problem: Turning iterative self-evolution with environment feedback from a purely inference-time heuristic into a trainable capability: given prior attempts plus execution feedback, the model should reliably produce a meaningfully improved next attempt, learning how to diagnose weaknesses and exploit historical trajectories rather than just solving tasks in one shot.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model researchers is methodological rather than a new pretraining recipe: it reframes the objective from absolute task completion to relative improvement across rounds, aligning training with test-time scaling loops (generate→run→feedback→revise). Using execution-derived, continuous rewards (correctness + runtime) provides a scalable signal for learning multi-round refinement policies, which standard RLHF or single-turn verifiable RL typically does not target explicitly. Direct impact on base pretraining is limited, but it informs how to build trajectory data and rewards that incentivize real progress instead of verbose self-reflection.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MetaEvolve combines (i) trajectory-aware data synthesis, (ii) evolution-aware RL, and (iii) inference-time evolutionary search.
- Data synthesis: starting from ~25k coding problems, sample multiple candidate programs per problem (example: 10). Apply a two-stage diversity filtering to keep problems/solution pools where attempts are sufficiently different, using simple structural proxies (e.g., character length and line count differences) to ensure the history contains learnable variation.
- Evolution-aware RL: train the model on inputs that explicitly include the current solution, performance feedback, and a history of prior attempts; the target is an improved program. Rewards are verifiable via execution and include continuous runtime signals in addition to correctness, making “working vs. better-working” optimizable.
- Inference-time loop: keep the same multi-round generate-and-evaluate loop at test time, so the model is trained under a distribution closer to how it will be used.
Key distinction from common coding RL: the optimized behavior is multi-round improvement conditioned on trajectory context, not just maximizing pass@k or single-shot acceptance.
summary_en.experiments: Across seven coding benchmarks, MetaEvolve reports gains over the strongest baseline in absolute average improvement rate: +10.01% in-distribution and +24.12% out-of-distribution. On AlgoTune (open-ended algorithm optimization beyond the training domain), it reports a 46.91% relative improvement. The paper also includes novelty/structural diversity analysis (Table 3) and qualitative comparisons showing more targeted diagnosis and progressive restructuring vs. a naive evolution baseline (Figure 2). Practical questions to verify in the full method/appendix: reward normalization for runtime, handling timeouts/noise, RL algorithm details (KL control, sampling), and robustness against reward hacking via micro-optimizations.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Figure 1 for the end-to-end loop and how training matches inference.
2) The data synthesis + diversity filtering section: it largely determines whether the model learns trajectory-conditioned improvement or just “rewrite differently”.
3) Reward construction from execution signals: how correctness and efficiency are combined and safeguarded.
4) Tables for OOD and AlgoTune results (Table 2/4), then ablations: removing history, removing diversity filtering, correctness-only reward, SFT-only vs. RL, etc.

recommendation.zh: 看数据合成和 reward 设计即可；把“会迭代”单独训练是对 RLVR 的合理补丁，但需警惕只在代码执行域成立。
recommendation.en: Skim the data synthesis and reward design; training iteration as a separate skill is a sensible RLVR patch, but the evidence may be coding-execution-specific.

paper.title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
paper.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly solve complex tasks by constructing inference-time workflows that combine reasoning, tool use, and code execution. While such workflows enable flexible problem solving, the useful procedures discovered during execution are often transient: they help solve the current task but are not retained in a form that can systematically benefit future tasks. We present FlowEvo, a training-free framework that compiles successful traces into reusable skill records. Ea

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent推理时构建的有效工作流无法持久化复用，仅能解决当前任务，无法系统性增益后续任务的问题
summary.importance: 通用Agent方法创新，提出训练无关的自进化框架，实现工作流与可执行技能的双向共进化
summary.technical_approach: 提出FlowEvo训练无关框架，包含三个耦合机制：1）工作流转技能编译，从成功执行轨迹中提取可复用的可执行工件及辅助结构化指导，经接口、重放、安全检查后存入技能库；2）技能到工作流的反馈，检索积累的技能支持后续任务的直接执行或工作流构建；3）共进化循环，技能积累优化工作流构建效率，新的成功轨迹进一步扩充技能库
summary.experiments: 原文摘要截断，未披露具体模型规模、训练数据、对比基线及量化效果，需查阅正文补充
summary.authors_note: 东南大学、伦斯勒理工学院、香港科技大学联合团队工作，无知名LLM领域作者

summary_en.core_problem: Effective workflows constructed by LLM agents during inference are transient and cannot be persisted to systematically benefit future tasks
summary_en.importance: General agent method innovation, proposes a training-free self-evolution framework enabling bidirectional co-evolution of workflows and executable skills
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes FlowEvo training-free framework with three coupled mechanisms: 1) workflow-to-skill compilation that extracts reusable executable artifacts from successful traces with interface/replay/safety checks; 2) skill-to-workflow feedback that retrieves accumulated skills for future tasks; 3) co-evolution loop where skill accumulation improves workflow construction and new traces expand the skill bank
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated, no specific model scale, training data, baselines or quantitative results disclosed; refer to full paper for details
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from Southeast University, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute and HKUST, no well-known LLM researchers involved

recommendation.zh: Agent推理时技能持久化复用的思路有一定参考性，但摘要截断无实验数据，仅作为方法思路备查
recommendation.en: Inference-time skill persistence idea for agents has minor reference value, but abstract is truncated with no experiments; use as method reference only.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Verifiable Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Dialogue Skills via Future-Feedback Prediction
paper.abstract: Textual skills provide a lightweight way to improve frozen language-model agents, but their self-evolution normally requires a stable validation signal. Such signals are natural in mathematics or code, where an answer can be checked after it changes, yet are problematic in open-ended dialogue: changing the assistant response also changes the user's next reaction, so a logged reaction cannot directly evaluate a counterfactual response. We propose future-feedback skill evolution, which first redir

summary.core_problem: 解决开放式对话中自进化缺乏稳定验证信号的问题：修改当前回答会改变未来用户反馈，导致离线日志无法直接评估反事实回答质量。
summary.importance: 贡献属于后训练与自我改进方法，核心是把开放式对话优化改写成可验证的 future-feedback prediction 任务；对预训练研究员的价值主要在于“如何从不稳定交互信号中提炼可训练监督”。
summary.technical_approach: 先不直接优化当前回答，而是学习一个 textual skill 去预测已观察回答是否会带来正/负的后续用户信号；由于预测对象绑定在固定日志 tuple 上，因此可做 validation-gated textual optimization。进化出的反馈技能再作为诊断器和优化目标，反过来指导 answer skills。
summary.experiments: 在一个隐私保护的销售助手数据集上验证，摘要称该方法能稳定提升开放式对话技能自进化效果，并得到可解释的反馈标准。未给出基座模型规模、数据量、具体提升幅度和公开基线细节，因此证据强度目前一般。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of stable validation signals for self-evolving open-ended dialogue skills: changing the current answer changes future user feedback, so logged reactions cannot directly evaluate counterfactual responses.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training/self-improvement contribution. Its main value is reframing open-ended dialogue optimization into a verifiable future-feedback prediction task. For pretraining researchers, the interesting part is how unstable interaction signals can be converted into trainable supervision.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of directly optimizing the current answer, the method learns a textual skill that predicts whether an observed answer will lead to positive or negative future user signals. Because the prediction target is attached to fixed logged tuples, it supports validation-gated textual optimization. The evolved feedback skill then serves as both a diagnostic and an optimization target for answer skills.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on a privacy-preserving sales-assistant dataset and is claimed to improve open-ended dialogue skill self-evolution while yielding interpretable feedback criteria. The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, exact gains, or strong public baselines, so the evidence is only moderately convincing at this stage.

recommendation.zh: 想看的是“把不可验证对话奖励改写成可验证预测任务”这个接口设计，不必太信应用结果；若做 RL-pretrain 闭环，可拿来类比 reward model target 设计。
recommendation.en: The useful idea is the interface trick—turning unverifiable dialogue reward into a verifiable prediction target; don’t over-index on the application result, but it’s relevant if you think about RL-to-pretrain signal design.

paper.title: Self-Modifying Lean Proof Agents with Verifier-Grounded Benchmark Coevolution
paper.abstract: Designing effective Lean proof agents is a central challenge in formal mathematical reasoning. Beyond building stronger provers, recent work emphasizes the workflow around Lean: how an agent decomposes proof obligations, uses tools and compiler feedback, diagnoses failures, repairs proofs, and maintains structured proof context. Motivated by code-level self-evolving agents, we study whether such workflows can be evolved rather than hand-designed. We present a self-evolving Lean proof agent in wh

summary.core_problem: 研究 Lean 证明 agent 的工作流是否可以自动演化，而不是由人工设计分解、调用工具、读取编译器反馈、修复证明的流程。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 方法探索。它把形式化证明中的 verifier 作为相对干净的训练信号，并把 agent 自修改与任务分布更新放在同一个闭环里，对 verifier-grounded reasoning agent 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 系统保留一个小的可信运行时，其余 workspace 可变，包括证明工作流、prompt 和工具。每一代选出最高分 champion，由它通过 mastery-throttled curriculum 更新当前任务分布：只有当前难度被掌握后才引入更难证明义务，并用单锚点重校准来约束任务漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、Lean 任务数量、训练代数、基线和具体提升幅度。可确认的是实验围绕代际演化：agent 在当前 Lean 任务分布上得分，champion 再修改后续任务分布与工作流。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether Lean proof-agent workflows can be evolved automatically rather than hand-designed around decomposition, tool use, compiler feedback, diagnosis, and proof repair.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-method study. Its useful angle is treating the Lean verifier as a relatively clean grounding signal and coupling self-modifying agent workflows with curriculum evolution.
summary_en.technical_approach: A small trusted runtime wraps a mutable workspace containing prompts, tools, and proof workflows. Across generations, the best-scoring champion updates the active task distribution through a mastery-throttled curriculum, introducing harder proof obligations only after the current level is mastered, with recalibration to limit drift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, number of Lean tasks, generations, baselines, or quantitative gains. The described setup evaluates agents on active Lean tasks and lets the champion revise both workflow and future task distribution.

recommendation.zh: Lean verifier 是干净奖励源，但自改 workflow 加共演 benchmark 容易过拟合；看系统循环即可。
recommendation.en: Lean gives a clean verifier signal, but self-modifying workflows plus coevolved benchmarks can overfit; skim the loop design only.

paper.title: From Atomic Actions to Standard Operating Procedures: Iterative Tool Optimization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Tool utilization enables Large Language Model (LLM) agents to interact with the real world and resolve complex tasks. However, existing agent frameworks predominantly rely on static toolsets composed of granular atomic actions (e.g., basic file I/O or single-turn search), which forces agents to reinvent low-level logic for every recurring workflow, leading to increased reasoning overhead and failure rates. In this study, we propose that agents can achieve self-evolution by synthesizing these ato

summary.core_problem: 让工具增强型 LLM agent 不再只依赖静态的原子工具（atomic actions），而是能从自身执行轨迹中抽取可复用的多步流程（SOP，高阶工具），并通过迭代的合并/评估/剪枝持续优化工具集，降低长链推理与交互轮次带来的失败率。
summary.importance: 对“基座预训练/训练动态/数据效率”相关性较弱，更偏 agent 系统工程与工具管理。可借鉴点主要在：把长轨迹压缩成可调用子程序，可能减少推理 token 与交互成本；以及“工具集会膨胀，需要生命周期管理”的经验。但它不涉及预训练目标、数据配比、tokenizer、scaling 或训练稳定性等核心问题。
summary.technical_approach:
EvoSOP 框架是模型无关的系统循环：
- 从 agent 的执行轨迹里识别重复且有效的原子动作序列，将其抽象为 SOP（可调用的高阶工具，封装多步逻辑）。
- 在同一迭代周期内做工具集治理：合并冗余 SOP、基于历史表现评估并剪枝低效工具，避免工具集膨胀带来的决策噪声。
- 形式化上把 agent 交互建模为 ReAct 风格的 reasoning+tool-call 序列，并把 persona/goal/history/memory/toolset 作为上下文状态的一部分。
summary.experiments: 摘要与引言层面只给出定性结论：在多个 benchmark 上提升任务成功率并减少交互轮次，相比若干 baseline 更好。你提供的全文片段未包含具体 benchmark 名称、成功率提升幅度、平均轮次下降、以及对“合并/剪枝策略”的消融；需要在实验章节与附录表格中核对。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，优先看：
- Introduction：问题定义（原子工具导致长链推理开销、工具集膨胀）与 EvoSOP 的迭代生命周期。
- 方法章节中 SOP 抽取、评估指标、合并与剪枝规则（这些决定了是否可迁移到你的 agent 框架）。
预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟；若只关心预训练研究，可跳过。

summary_en.core_problem: How to let tool-augmented LLM agents evolve beyond static atomic tools by extracting reusable multi-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) from their own execution trajectories, and iteratively managing the toolset (merge/evaluate/prune) to reduce long-horizon reasoning overhead and failures.
summary_en.importance: Only loosely connected to foundation-model pretraining. The main transferable insight is toolset lifecycle management: compressing recurring long action chains into callable routines can reduce interaction rounds and token budget, while uncontrolled tool growth can add decision noise. It does not contribute to pretraining objectives, data/tokenization, scaling laws, or optimization dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach:
EvoSOP is a model-agnostic system loop:
- Mine execution trajectories to identify recurring, useful sequences of atomic actions and package them as higher-order SOP tools.
- Iteratively optimize the toolset by merging redundant SOPs and pruning low-utility tools based on historical performance, preventing toolset bloat.
- Uses a ReAct-like agent formalization where context includes persona, goal, interaction history, external memory, and the current toolset.
summary_en.experiments: The excerpt reports qualitative outcomes: higher task success rates and fewer interaction rounds across multiple benchmarks versus baselines. The provided text does not include benchmark names, exact deltas, or ablations for SOP construction/merging/pruning; those need to be checked in the experiment section and appendix tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the motivation and the iterative tool-optimization lifecycle, then jump to the method details on SOP extraction and pruning/merging criteria (the parts that determine portability). Budget ~20–30 minutes. If your focus is pretraining research, this is optional.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和消融；高阶工具自举是好方向，但要重点查 SOP 库是否吃了测试分布。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; higher-order tool bootstrapping is promising, but check whether the SOP library absorbs the test distribution.

paper.title: Neuron-Aware Data Selection for Annotation-Free LLM Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Post-training large language models (LLMs) without real-world interaction feedback or human-labeled supervision remains challenging, particularly in specialized domains where expert annotations are costly to obtain. Recent annotation-free self-evolution methods address this by using the model's own outputs as supervision signals, constructing a teacher via additional context and aggregating predictions across multiple rollouts through majority voting to produce pseudo-labels. However, these appr

summary.core_problem: 该工作处理的是无标注场景下的 LLM 自蒸馏数据构造问题：当教师和学生来自同一个模型、教师只通过 few-shot 上下文获得更强条件信息时，如何选择训练样本和示例上下文，避免把模型自身的幻觉、错误校准和伪推理继续蒸馏回模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在数据选择信号，而不是新的大规模训练 recipe。它把模型内部激活作为无标注数据筛选和上下文构造的依据，补充了只看 majority vote、entropy、answer correctness 这类外部行为信号的路线。对基座研究员有用的一点是：自训练数据的质量不只取决于答案是否稳定，还取决于样本是否处在“可靠但仍有改进空间”的区间。这个观察可以迁移到持续预训练、领域继续训练、合成数据过滤和 post-train 数据退火中。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Neuron On-Policy Self-Distillation，核心是用同一个模型构造学生分布和教师分布。学生只看原始问题，教师看带有检索示例的增强上下文，然后用教师的 token-level 分布监督学生，避免 GRPO 这类只给轨迹级标量奖励的粗粒度信用分配问题。数据侧有两个模块。第一是 Neuron Consensus，用激活神经元数量刻画样本可靠性。作者观察到激活数量和幻觉、不可靠行为有相关性，但单独选择高激活或低激活样本并不稳定，说明“可靠性”不是唯一目标，训练收益还要求教师和学生之间存在可学习的分布差距。第二是 Neuron Overlap，用激活神经元集合的重叠来检索 few-shot 示例，选择与当前 query 推理模式更接近的样本作为教师上下文。这样做的关键区别是：教师并不是外部强模型，也不是人工标注器，而是同一模型在更合适上下文下被诱导出的分布；因此上下文检索质量直接决定蒸馏信号质量。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个数据集、六个源领域。结果显示，Neuron-OPSD 能获得有竞争力的自我改进，同时比 SFT 型自训练、GRPO 型自训练和 reward-based on-policy RL 更好地保留跨域泛化和校准表现。进一步分析指出，收益来自两个条件：模型在训练集上的初始能力不能太弱，否则自生成教师信号质量不足；教师-学生分布之间需要有足够 gap，否则蒸馏没有新增信息。四个 SciKnowEval 领域上的消融显示，Neuron Consensus 是有信息量的诊断信号，但作为单独筛选规则不够；Neuron Overlap 对教师上下文构造更直接有效。给定内容没有提供具体参数规模、训练 token 数、绝对分数和提升幅度，精读时需要补看实验表格。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分中 Neuron Consensus 的定义、激活统计的层选择和阈值策略，以及 Neuron Overlap 如何把 active neuron representation 转成检索特征。实验部分优先看三类结果：跨域性能是否真的保住、校准误差是否下降、只用 consensus 选数据为什么不稳定。最值得深挖的是“可靠但可改进”这个样本区间如何被度量；如果只给 activation count，而没有同时建模 teacher-student gap，数据选择很容易变成经验规则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies data construction for annotation-free LLM self-distillation. When the same model acts as both student and teacher, and the teacher is only strengthened through few-shot context, the key question is which unlabeled samples and which demonstrations should be used so that self-distillation does not reinforce the model’s own hallucinations, miscalibration, and spurious reasoning patterns.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining-oriented work is the data-selection perspective. The paper uses internal activations as label-free signals for filtering self-training data and building teacher contexts, rather than relying only on majority vote, entropy, or final-answer correctness. The main lesson is that useful self-training data should be reliable enough to avoid copying hallucinations, but still uncertain enough to leave room for a teacher-induced improvement. This idea is relevant to continual pretraining, domain adaptation, synthetic-data filtering, and data annealing for post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Neuron-OPSD performs on-policy self-distillation with a single model. The student predicts from the original query, while the teacher is the same model conditioned on retrieved few-shot demonstrations. The student is trained against the teacher’s token-level distribution, giving denser supervision than trajectory-level rewards in GRPO-style methods. The data pipeline has two neuron-based components. Neuron Consensus measures reliability using activation statistics, especially the number of activated neurons. The paper reports that this signal correlates with hallucinated or unreliable behavior, but is not sufficient as a standalone selection rule. Neuron Overlap retrieves demonstrations whose active-neuron patterns are close to the current query, aiming to induce a more useful teacher distribution. The main distinction from standard self-training is that context construction is treated as part of the supervision design, not as a fixed prompting detail.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover three datasets and six source domains. Neuron-OPSD is reported to deliver competitive self-improvement while preserving cross-domain generalization and calibration better than SFT-based self-training, GRPO-style variants, and reward-based on-policy RL. Additional analysis suggests that the gains depend on both the model’s initial capability on the training data and the distributional gap induced between teacher and student. Ablations on four SciKnowEval domains show that neuron consensus is informative but insufficient by itself, while neuron-overlap retrieval is a more direct mechanism for improving teacher-context quality. The provided text does not include exact parameter scales, token budgets, absolute scores, or improvement margins.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most readers. Focus on how Neuron Consensus is defined, which activations are counted, and how Neuron Overlap turns active-neuron patterns into retrieval features. In the experiments, check cross-domain retention, calibration error, and ablations separating sample selection from context retrieval. The most useful part to inspect carefully is the interaction between reliability and teacher-student gap; activation count alone is unlikely to be a stable data-selection rule.

recommendation.zh: 利用神经元激活状态来做 self-play 数据筛选，思路新颖，对 post-training 阶段的数据合成和质量控制有启发，值得看具体指标构建。
recommendation.en: Novel approach using neuron activations for self-play data filtering, inspiring for data synthesis and quality control in post-training; worth checking the specific metric construction.

paper.title: Recursive Self-Evolving Agents via Held-Out Selection
paper.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly improved without weight updates by evolving a natural-language artifact, such as reflections, workflows, playbooks, cheatsheets, or optimized prompts, that conditions a frozen policy. Such methods are typically reported as wins on the single benchmark where they help. We study them apples-to-apples and surface a sharper picture. We introduce RSEA, a Recursive Self-Evolving Agent that carries a compact three-layer natural-language state: an imperative strategy, reusabl

summary.core_problem: 不更新模型权重、仅通过演化自然语言上下文（反思、工作流、提示词等）来提升 LLM Agent 的方法，长期缺乏跨基准的公平对比，且普遍存在无约束提交导致的「上下文干扰」——注入的上下文反而让原本可用的基础策略性能大幅下降。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在训练信号质量与选择机制层面：上下文演化的可靠性不取决于演化对象本身，而取决于是否有严格的保留集选择门；这种「只在验证集不退化时才提交更新」的单调安全设计，可直接迁移到持续预训练、SFT/RL 的数据迭代与策略更新中，避免无约束更新带来的高方差与灾难性退化。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RSEA（递归自演化 Agent），核心设计有两点：一是将自然语言状态拆分为三层互补结构——命令式策略（高层前置规则）、可复用技能（原子子例程）、过程化手册（从成功轨迹蒸馏的具体步骤），解决了传统单形式 artifact 混淆不同类型知识的问题；二是把保留集选择门作为设计中心而非附属环节，每一代演化流程为：在小规模演化池上执行当前状态 → 基于轨迹重写全部三层状态 → 仅当候选状态在不相交的验证集上没有退化时才提交，始终冻结并使用当前最优状态，测试集完全隔离。RSEA_R 进一步在单任务重试循环中注入冻结的先验状态。
summary.experiments: 在统一骨干（7B 模型）、统一评测框架下复现了 Reflexion、GEPA、AWM、ACE、Dynamic Cheatsheet 等 6 种代表性方法，覆盖 ALFWorld、GAIA、τ-bench、WebShop 四个差异显著的基准，采用多种子与配对统计检验。关键结果：1）ALFWorld（134 任务 × 5 种子）上单轮演化先验显著优于 ReAct、GEPA、AWM，RSEA_R 达到 79.4% 的整体最优；2）在强骨干的工具使用基准上，没有任何自然语言 artifact 能稳定领先，RSEA 与 ReAct 统计持平且从未显著变差，仅 AWM 的具体工作流有稳定小幅提升；3）无保留集门的方法方差极高，Dynamic Cheatsheet 在 ALFWorld 接近最优（70.7%）但在 WebShop 上得分仅 0.136，远低于 ReAct 基线的 0.429，属于完全由注入上下文导致的灾难性退化；4）消融实验显示三层状态均有贡献（功能重叠而非严格互补），去掉保留集选择后会过拟合演化池：在演化集上 100% 正确，测试集下降 33 个百分点。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点放在第 2 节（动机与现有方法的 (form, update, selection) 三维分类框架）、第 4 节（RSEA 的三层状态结构与严格保留集门的设计细节）、第 7 节（跨基准的公平对比结果与上下文干扰的具体案例）、第 8 节（保留集门与状态层的消融）。预计阅读时间 40-50 分钟，核心是理解「选择门比演化对象更决定可靠性」这一结论，无需深究每个基准的任务细节。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agent improvement methods that evolve natural-language context artifacts (reflections, workflows, prompts) without updating model weights have long lacked fair cross-benchmark comparison. They also commonly suffer from unguarded commitment causing "context distraction"—injected context that severely degrades the otherwise capable base policy.
summary_en.importance: The primary implication for pretraining research lies in training signal quality and selection mechanisms: the reliability of context evolution depends less on the artifact being evolved than on the strictness of the held-out selection gate. This monotone-safe design—only committing updates that do not regress on a validation split—transfers directly to continual pretraining, SFT/RL data iteration, and policy update pipelines, where it mitigates high variance and catastrophic regression from unconstrained changes.
summary_en.technical_approach: RSEA (Recursive Self-Evolving Agent) has two core design choices. First, it decomposes the natural-language state into three complementary layers: an imperative strategy (high-level preamble), reusable skills (atomic sub-routines), and a procedural playbook (concrete steps distilled from successful trajectories)—resolving the conflation of distinct knowledge types in traditional single-form artifacts. Second, it centers the held-out selection gate rather than treating it as an afterthought. Each generation follows: roll out the current state on a small evolve pool, rewrite all three layers from the resulting trajectories, and commit the candidate only if it does not regress on a disjoint validation split. The frozen best state is always used for inference, and the test split is fully isolated. RSEA_R further injects this frozen prior into a per-task retry loop.
summary_en.experiments: Six representative methods (Reflexion, GEPA, AWM, ACE, Dynamic Cheatsheet, plus ReAct baseline) are re-implemented under a shared 7B backbone and unified harness, evaluated on four diverse benchmarks (ALFWorld, GAIA, τ-bench, WebShop) with multi-seed runs and paired statistical tests. Key results: 1) On ALFWorld (134 tasks × 5 seeds), the single-pass evolved prior significantly outperforms ReAct, GEPA, and AWM, and RSEA_R reaches 79.4% overall; 2) On strong-backbone tool-use benchmarks, no NL artifact dominates—RSEA is statistically tied with ReAct and never significantly worse, while only AWM's concrete workflows deliver consistent small gains; 3) Methods without a held-out gate exhibit extreme variance: Dynamic Cheatsheet goes from near-best on ALFWorld (70.7%) to a WebShop score of 0.136, far below the ReAct baseline of 0.429, a catastrophic regression caused entirely by injected context; 4) Ablations confirm all three state layers contribute (they overlap rather than being strictly complementary), and removing held-out selection leads to severe evolve-pool overfitting: 100% in-sample accuracy with a 33-point drop on test.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority: Section 2 (motivation and the (form, update, selection) taxonomy for existing methods), Section 4 (details of the three-layer state structure and strict held-out gate), Section 7 (cross-benchmark fair comparison results and concrete context-distraction cases), and Section 8 (ablations on the gate and state layers). Estimated reading time: 40–50 minutes. Focus on the core finding that the selection gate, not the evolved artifact, determines reliability; deep per-benchmark task details are not essential.

recommendation.zh: 留出集防退化的gate设计可直接迁移到合成数据筛选与RL策略迭代，重点看§3.2的选择机制与§4的泛化性实验
recommendation.en: The held-out anti-regression gate design can be directly transferred to synthetic data filtering and RL policy iteration, focus on §3.2 selection mechanism and §4 generalization experiments.

paper.title: QueenBee Planner: Skill-Evolving Communication Topologies for Token-Efficient LLM Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems increasingly depend not only on how individual agents reason, but also on how agents are connected. This paper introduces QueenBee Planner, a framework that treats inter-agent communication topology as a retrievable and self-improving design skill. A pool of worker agents, the task adapter, and the scoring function are frozen; only an outer LLM planner learns to generate temporal communication DAGs specifying who sends information to whom, in which

summary.core_problem: 如何优化 LLM 多智能体系统中的通信拓扑结构，以在保证性能的同时提高 token 效率？
summary.importance: 将多智能体通信拓扑视为一种可检索和自我进化的设计技能，提出了一种通过外部 LLM 规划器动态生成和优化通信 DAG 的框架，减少了不必要的通信开销。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 QueenBee Planner 框架。冻结 worker agents、任务适配器和评分函数，仅让外部 LLM 规划器学习生成时间通信 DAG（有向无环图）。通过执行轨迹提取包含“保留”、“修改”和“避免”三种动作的设计规则。引入了保留接受门、方差感知信用分配、motif 级别归因等机制，防止自我进化陷入局部最优或错误策略。
summary.experiments: 在 Count-Frequency 聚合等任务上进行了评估（摘要截断，具体效果未知）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to optimize the communication topology in LLM multi-agent systems to improve token efficiency while maintaining performance?
summary_en.importance: Treats multi-agent communication topology as a retrievable and self-evolving design skill, proposing a framework to dynamically generate and optimize communication DAGs via an outer LLM planner, reducing unnecessary communication overhead.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the QueenBee Planner framework. Freezes worker agents, task adapters, and scoring functions, allowing only an outer LLM planner to learn to generate temporal communication DAGs. Extracts design rules with 'Preserve', 'Modify', and 'Avoid' actions from execution traces. Introduces mechanisms like held-out acceptance gates and motif-level attribution to prevent self-evolution from falling into local optima or false policies.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on tasks like Count-Frequency aggregation (abstract truncated, specific results unknown).

recommendation.zh: 关注多智能体通信拓扑的动态优化，对设计高效的 multi-agent 协作机制有一定参考价值，但与底层预训练关系不大。
recommendation.en: Focuses on dynamic optimization of multi-agent communication topology; holds some reference value for designing efficient multi-agent collaboration mechanisms, but has little relevance to underlying pre-training.

paper.title: Ask, Solve, Generate: Self-Evolving Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation via Self-Consistency Rewards
paper.abstract: Most unified large multimodal models (LMMs) that support both visual understanding and image generation still rely on curated post-training supervision, such as human annotations, preference labels, or external reward models. We ask whether a unified LMM can improve both abilities autonomously using only unlabeled images. We propose a self-evolving training framework with three internal roles: a Proposer that generates visual questions, a Solver that answers and evaluates them, and a Generator t

summary.core_problem: 现有支持“理解+生成”的统一多模态模型后训练高度依赖人工标注数据，已有的无监督自进化方法存在两个核心缺陷：一是样本级自洽奖励容易退化为低熵的无信息一致信号，导致训练不稳定；二是理解与生成任务优化目标脱节，理解能力提升无法有效传导到生成质量，且现有方法通常仅在单一生成范式上验证，通用性不足。
summary.importance: 该工作验证了完全使用无标注图像同时提升多模态理解与生成能力的可行性，提出的token级不确定性奖励、理解模型介导的生成评估方案，为跨任务自监督优化提供了可迁移的思路，对混合AR+扩散架构的统一多模态模型预训练后持续优化有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 基于冻结的统一多模态主干，训练三个LoRA功能角色：Proposer生成视觉问题，Solver回答问题并作为内部评估器，Generator合成图像。针对奖励退化问题，提出Solver Token Entropy（STE）指标，用token级预测不确定性作为连续的难度度量，解决样本级自洽饱和后无有效训练信号的问题，支撑冷启动阶段的课程学习；针对跨任务耦合弱的问题，用Solver作为生成结果的内置评估器，结合QA保真度（生成图像是否匹配prompt描述属性）、循环一致性（生成图像重打caption与原prompt的匹配度）、多样性三个维度计算生成奖励，让理解能力的提升直接优化生成奖励的质量。整个训练流程不需要人工标注或外部奖励模型，且适配不同生成范式。
summary.experiments: 在三类采用不同生成范式的统一多模态模型上完成验证：扩散架构BLIP3o、整流流架构BAGEL、自回归架构VARGPT-v1.1。同一套训练流程在三个主干上均获得一致提升：理解类百分点指标提升1.9~3.6，MME子项获得双位数提升，GenEval生成指标提升3%，未出现跨任务性能权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点关注方法部分对奖励退化问题的解决方案（STE设计）、跨任务耦合的评估机制，以及跨三类生成范式的通用实验设置，理解同一套流程适配不同架构的核心逻辑，无需关注特定主干的实现细节，预计阅读时间18分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing unified multimodal models supporting both visual understanding and image generation rely heavily on curated annotated data for post-training. Prior unsupervised self-evolution methods suffer from two core limitations: sample-level self-consistency rewards often degenerate into low-entropy, uninformative agreement signals that cause training instability; understanding and generation objectives are poorly coupled, so improvements in understanding do not transfer to generation quality, and existing methods are usually validated on a single generation paradigm with limited generality.
summary_en.importance: This work demonstrates the feasibility of improving both multimodal understanding and generation using only unlabeled images. The proposed token-level uncertainty reward and solver-mediated generation evaluation scheme provides a transferable recipe for cross-task self-supervised optimization, relevant to post-pretraining continual improvement of unified multimodal architectures including hybrid AR+diffusion designs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework trains three LoRA-based role adapters on a frozen unified multimodal backbone: a Proposer that generates visual questions, a Solver that answers questions and acts as an internal evaluator, and a Generator that synthesizes images. To address reward degeneracy, Solver Token Entropy (STE) is introduced as a continuous difficulty measure derived from token-level prediction uncertainty, which remains informative even when sample-level consistency saturates, enabling curriculum learning from cold start. To address weak cross-task coupling, the Solver is used as an evaluator for generated images, combining QA fidelity (whether generated images match prompt attributes), cycle consistency (match between re-captioned generated images and original prompts), and diversity to compute generation rewards, so improvements in understanding directly sharpen reward signals for generation. The full pipeline requires no human annotations or external reward models, and is designed to be portable across generation paradigms.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across three unified multimodal backbones spanning fundamentally different generation paradigms: diffusion-based BLIP3o, rectified-flow-based BAGEL, and autoregressive VARGPT-v1.1. The same training recipe delivers consistent gains across all three backbones: 1.9 to 3.6 point improvements on percentage-based understanding metrics, double-digit gains on MME sub-scores, and +3% on the GenEval generation benchmark, with no observed cross-task performance tradeoffs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this paper. Prioritize the design of STE for resolving reward degeneracy, the solver-mediated cross-task evaluation mechanism, and the cross-paradigm experimental setup to understand why the recipe works across different generation architectures. Implementation-specific training details for individual backbones can be skipped unless adapting the method to a new model. Expected reading time: 18 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 三角色自博弈+token熵难度调度的设计对统一多模态自训练有参考，重点看§3.2的STE信号定义和§4.3的生成任务评估方案。
recommendation.en: The three-role self-play plus token-entropy difficulty scheduling design is informative for unified multimodal self-training; focus on §3.2 for STE definition and §4.3 for generation evaluation scheme.

paper.title: Paying More Attention to Visual Tokens in Self-Evolving Large Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Recently, self-evolving large multimodal models (LMMs) have received attention for improving visual reasoning in a purely unsupervised setting. However, multi-role self-play and self-consistency reward schemes in existing self-evolving LMMs optimize answer agreement without ensuring the decoder attends to visual content, relying instead on statistical language priors to produce self consistent outputs. This leads to a persistent failure mode we term visual under-conditioning, where the decoder r

summary.core_problem: 现有无监督自进化多模态模型以答案自洽为优化目标，训练过程中解码器会依赖统计语言先验而非真实视觉输入生成结果，产生视觉欠条件（visual under-conditioning）问题：生成时对视觉token注意力不足，出现幻觉、模态旁路，在需要细粒度视觉感知的描述、区域定位类任务上性能甚至低于基模型。
summary.importance: 该工作明确指出了自进化LMM训练中一个普遍存在的信号偏差：自洽奖励不等价于正确的视觉接地。提出的不变性正则思路为多模态模型无标注对齐、持续优化提供了可复用的方案，对统一多模态模型预训练后的无监督迭代有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VISE框架，放弃传统多角色自博弈设计，采用单模型自提问模式，全程不需要人工标注、元数据或外部奖励模型。训练信号来自两个互补的不变性奖励，直接约束模型的视觉条件依赖而非答案一致性：1）几何不变性奖励：对图像施加已知空间变换（裁剪、缩放等）后，要求模型给出的目标定位、描述结果保持空间一致；2）语义不变性奖励：对模型预测的目标区域做局部扰动遮挡后，要求模型能够识别对应视觉证据缺失，无法输出原预测结果。
summary.experiments: 在覆盖图像描述、VQA、视觉推理、幻觉检测的18个基准上，跨4类主干网络、多个模型规模完成验证：COCO描述CIDEr最高提升16.85，TextCaps CIDEr提升19.66，Chair-I物体幻觉指标降低5.0点，VQA和推理基准也获得一致提升，消除了过往自进化方法“推理性能上升、细粒度描述性能下降”的权衡问题。注意力可视化验证，训练后解码器各层对视觉token的注意力权重显著提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点关注引言部分对视觉欠条件现象的定义和实证观察，以及两个不变性奖励的设计逻辑，实验部分的注意力分析结果可快速浏览，无需深究训练超参数细节，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing unsupervised self-evolving large multimodal models optimize for answer self-consistency during training, which allows decoders to rely on statistical language priors instead of actual visual input. This causes visual under-conditioning: insufficient attention to visual tokens during generation, leading to hallucinations, modality bypass, and degraded performance on fine-grained vision-language tasks such as captioning and region-level description, where performance often drops below the base model level.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a pervasive training signal bias in self-evolving LMM pipelines: self-consistency rewards do not guarantee proper visual grounding. The proposed invariance-based regularization provides a reusable recipe for unsupervised alignment and continual optimization of multimodal models, with direct relevance to post-pretraining iteration of unified multimodal systems without labeled data.
summary_en.technical_approach: The VISE framework replaces prior multi-role self-play setups with a single-model self-questioning pipeline, requiring no human annotations, metadata, or external reward models. Training uses two complementary invariance rewards that directly regularize visual conditioning rather than answer agreement: (1) Geometric invariance reward enforces spatial consistency of localization and description outputs under known image transformations such as cropping and scaling; (2) Semantic invariance reward requires the model to detect missing visual evidence when predicted object regions are occluded, so predictions cannot be generated without corresponding visual support.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across 18 benchmarks covering image captioning, VQA, visual reasoning, and hallucination detection, across 4 backbone families at multiple scales. The method delivers up to +16.85 CIDEr on COCO, +19.66 CIDEr on TextCaps, 5.0 point reduction on the Chair-I object hallucination metric, with consistent gains on VQA and reasoning benchmarks. It eliminates the previously observed tradeoff between improved reasoning performance and degraded fine-grained visual description. Attention analysis confirms increased attention weight on visual tokens across decoder layers after training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim this paper. Prioritize the introduction section for the empirical characterization of visual under-conditioning, and the design rationale for the two invariance rewards. The attention analysis in the experiments section is worth a quick look, but detailed hyperparameter ablations can be skipped unless implementing the method. Expected reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 视觉欠条件化这个失效模式的诊断对VLM对齐有启发，只看§3的奖励设计和§4的注意力可视化即可，方法本身是自监督后训练的增量改进。
recommendation.en: The diagnosis of visual under-conditioning is insightful for VLM alignment; read only §3 for reward design and §4 for attention visualizations, the method itself is incremental self-supervised post-training.

paper.title: Marginal Advantage Accumulation for Memory-Driven Agent Self-Evolution
paper.abstract: In batch-style trace distillation, the same memory operation may receive contradictory feedback across different batches. Existing methods lack a cross-batch, operation-level evidence accumulation mechanism, making it impossible to distinguish stably effective operations from accidental hits. This paper formalizes the requirement as two structural conditions, alignability and comparability, and proposes Marginal Advantage Accumulation (MAA).
