summary.core_problem: 在“离线、分 batch”的 trace distillation 里，同一个记忆操作（memory op）会在不同 batch 上收到相互矛盾的反馈；现有方法缺少跨 batch、以“操作”为粒度的证据累积机制，导致系统难以区分“稳定有效的改进”与“偶然命中”。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，更偏向 agent 记忆/自进化的后处理与训练信号聚合。但它把一个常见工程痛点讲清楚：当监督信号来自噪声较大的 proxy（LLM judge）且数据分布随 batch 漂移时，单 batch 的排序/筛选会系统性过拟合；需要可对齐（identity）与可比（scale）两类结构条件，才能做跨批次的长期信用分配。这种“差分 + 证据累积”的思路，对持续学习/在线数据筛选/合成数据过滤也有可迁移的启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名为 Marginal Advantage Accumulation (MAA)，定位为 distillation 的后处理架构层。
1) 两个结构条件：
- Alignability（可对齐）：跨 batch 识别语义等价的操作，并合并到同一累积单元，否则无法累积证据。
- Comparability（可比）：不同 batch 任务分布不同，必须把每次评估信号变成同尺度、可加的量，否则跨 batch 相加没有意义。
2) 可对齐的实现：把 memory bank 抽象成带稳定 id 的 item 集合；每个 op 用 (type, anchor id, content embedding) 标识；新候选与已有 op 语义相似度超过阈值则做 semantic identity merging，避免“同义不同表述”导致证据碎片化。
3) 可比的实现（核心）：对每个候选 op_i，在当前 batch B 上做外层差分：
- 先用 LLM judge 估计 u(M,B)∈[0,100]，表示当前记忆 M 在 batch B 上的期望效用；
- 构造应用该 op 后的记忆 M_i，再估计 u(M_i,B)；
- 定义边际优势 δ_i = u(M_i,B) - u(M,B) ∈ [-100,100]。
差分把 batch 的“绝对难度/分布差异”尽量抵消，使 δ 更接近 op 的增量贡献，从而可跨 batch 累加。
4) 证据累积：对每个 op 单元 k，在时间/批次维度上对 δ_{k,t} 做带符号的 EMA 累积，形成稳定的长期证据；论文强调不要求 u 无偏，只要求 δ 的方向与真实增益方向“统计上优于随机”（directional alignment）。
整体上，MAA把“选择一次”改成“持续记账”：不直接用单次 accept/reject，而是用跨批次的累积证据驱动保留、抑制或回滚某类操作。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称在 4 个 benchmark × 4 个 target model 的 16 组设置里，MAA 在 14/16 组取得最好结果，并且作为 post-processing 架构能稳定超过若干现有 trace distillation 方法（文中点名 SkillOpt、Trace2Skill 等）。但给定你提供的全文片段未包含实验表格与具体数值（提升幅度、置信区间、judge 设定、合并阈值、EMA 超参等），无法在不臆测的前提下复述关键数字与消融结论。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 重点看 Introduction 对“batch-style distillation 为什么会产生矛盾反馈”的例子与问题抽象，确认它解决的是“跨 batch 信号聚合”而不是更强的在线验证。
- 精看 §3.1（identity merging 的定义、相似度/阈值、anchor id 设计）与 §3.2–3.3（δ 的构造与 EMA 累积），这是方法是否可复现、是否会引入新偏差的关键。
- 看实验部分时优先核对三点：① u(M,B) 的 judge 提示词与一致性；② δ 差分是否真的降低 batch 间方差（有没有方差/相关性分析）；③ identity merging 的误合并/漏合并对最终收益的敏感性（阈值消融）。

summary_en.core_problem: In offline, batch-wise trace distillation for memory-driven agent self-evolution, the same memory operation can receive conflicting feedback across batches. Existing methods lack an operation-level, cross-batch evidence accumulation mechanism, making it hard to separate consistently helpful edits from accidental wins.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining; it is primarily an agent-memory distillation/post-processing layer. The transferable value is the framing: when supervision is a noisy proxy (LLM judge) and the task distribution shifts across batches, per-batch selection overfits. The paper argues you need (1) identity alignment across batches and (2) scale comparability of signals to do meaningful long-horizon credit assignment. The “difference signal + EMA evidence ledger” pattern can inform continual data filtering, synthetic-data acceptance, or any setting where you aggregate noisy gains over drifting batches.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Marginal Advantage Accumulation (MAA) is introduced as an architectural layer on top of existing batch distillation.
- Structural requirements:
  1) Alignability: semantically equivalent operations must be recognized and merged across batches.
  2) Comparability: signals must be on a consistent scale across batches to be additively accumulated.
- Alignability mechanism: represent the memory bank as a set of items with stable IDs; each op is keyed by (type, anchor id, content embedding). New candidates are merged into an existing op unit when semantic similarity exceeds a threshold, preventing evidence fragmentation due to paraphrases.
- Comparability mechanism (core): use an outer-loop difference signal per batch. An LLM judge estimates an expected utility u(M,B) in [0,100] for memory M on batch B. For each candidate op_i, form M_i and compute δ_i = u(M_i,B) − u(M,B). The differencing is intended to cancel batch-specific difficulty/distribution effects and isolate the marginal contribution of the op.
- Accumulation: for each op unit k, aggregate signed δ_{k,t} over batches via EMA, yielding a persistent evidence score used to retain/suppress operations. The method does not require u to be unbiased—only that δ is directionally correlated with true gains better than chance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports best performance in 14/16 settings (4 benchmarks × 4 target models) and consistent wins as a post-processing module over prior trace-distillation baselines (e.g., SkillOpt, Trace2Skill). The provided full-text excerpt does not include the experimental tables/figures or concrete numbers (gains, variance, judge setup, hyperparameters), so specific quantitative results and ablations cannot be reliably reproduced here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the precise failure mode: contradictory proxy feedback across batches under offline distillation.
- Focus on §3.1 (semantic identity merging details: similarity metric, thresholds, anchor design) and §3.2–§3.3 (how δ is computed and how EMA is applied).
- When checking experiments, validate: (1) judge prompting and consistency, (2) whether differencing reduces cross-batch variance (any variance/correlation analysis), and (3) sensitivity to merge threshold (false merges vs missed merges).

recommendation.zh: 将 RL 中的优势函数估计思路引入到 Agent 轨迹蒸馏中，通过 EMA 跨 batch 平滑奖励信号，对做 Agent SFT/RL 数据构造的同学有工程参考价值。
recommendation.en: Adapts advantage estimation from RL to agent trace distillation, smoothing reward signals across batches via EMA; offers practical engineering value for those constructing SFT/RL data for agents.

paper.title: HarnessX: A Composable, Adaptive, and Evolvable Agent Harness Foundry
paper.abstract: AI agent performance depends critically on the runtime harness, comprising the prompts, tools, memory, and control flow that mediate how a model observes, reasons, and acts. Yet today's harnesses remain largely hand-crafted and static: each new model or task still demands bespoke scaffolding, and the rich traces produced during execution are rarely distilled back into systematic improvement. We introduce HarnessX, a foundry for composable, adaptive, and evolvable agent harnesses. HarnessX assemb

summary.core_problem: 现有AI智能体的运行时harness（包括提示词、工具、记忆、控制流等介导模型观察、推理、行动的组件）均为手工定制的静态系统，存在三大核心问题：模型/工具/任务域变化时需重新定制，无经验驱动的改进机制；各组件架构耦合，修改易出错、复用依赖复制；harness工程与模型训练完全割裂，执行轨迹数据被丢弃，无法实现协同优化。
summary.importance: 明确了harness是智能体能力的一等决定因素，而非外围工程补丁，其优化增益常超过模型小版本迭代的收益。提出的harness-模型协同进化框架将harness优化产生的轨迹复用为RL训练信号，同时打破了单独harness优化的性能天花板与单独模型RL的训练信号天花板。对智能体后训练的数据流水线设计、闭环优化机制有明确参考价值，可组合harness的形式化方法也为智能体工程标准化提供了基础。
summary.technical_approach: HarnessX是统一的harness铸造框架，包含三大核心模块：1）可组合harness：将harness形式化为一等类型化对象，由覆盖上下文、工具、技能、控制、记忆的类型化原语（processor）通过替换代数在生命周期钩子点插入组合，九维分类法覆盖完整行为空间，实现类型安全的组件增删改与完全解耦。2）AEGIS自适应进化引擎：将harness适配建模为符号工件（提示词、工具、记忆、控制策略）上的学习问题，通过四阶段流水线（Digester压缩轨迹、Planner规划适配方案、Evolver生成候选、Critic评估）结合全轨迹可观测性，解决对应RL的奖励黑客、灾难性遗忘、探索不足等风险；可选变体隔离策略避免异构任务集上的跨任务干扰。3）harness-模型协同进化：通过共享回放缓冲区，交替进行harness进化与模型GRPO训练，让模型内化不同版本harness的策略，形成闭环优化。
summary.experiments: 在5个基准（GAIA、ALFWorld、WebShop、τ³-Bench、SWE-bench Verified）、3类任务智能体（Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4、Qwen3.5-9B）上开展最多15轮进化实验。15组模型-基准配置中14组获得提升，平均绝对增益为+14.5%，最高增益达+44.0%（ALFWorld上的Qwen3.5-9B）。增益呈逆缩放规律：基线性能越弱的模型从harness进化中获益越大。在异构任务集GAIA上，单harness进化会出现停滞，变体隔离策略可恢复稳定提升（+13.6%，15轮无退化）。协同进化相比单独harness优化额外带来+4.7%的增益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先关注第1节中现有harness的三大核心问题定义、第3节的可组合harness核心设计、第4节的AEGIS四阶段进化流水线、第6节的主要实验结果（尤其是逆缩放规律与协同进化增益），预计阅读时间20-25分钟。若关注工程实现可查看第3节的类型化原语与替换代数细节，若关注训练闭环设计可重点阅读第5节的协同进化机制。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI agent runtime harnesses (including prompts, tools, memory, and control flow that mediate model observation, reasoning, and action) are hand-crafted, static systems with three core flaws: bespoke reengineering is required for any change in model, tooling, or task domain, with no mechanism for experience-driven improvement; components are architecturally entangled, leading to fragile modifications and copy-based reuse; harness engineering and model training operate in silos, with execution traces discarded rather than reused, preventing joint optimization.
summary_en.importance: The agent harness is established as a first-class determinant of agent capability rather than a peripheral engineering patch, with optimization gains that often exceed minor model version iterations. The proposed harness-model co-evolution framework repurposes traces from harness optimization as RL training signal, breaking both the performance ceiling of harness-only optimization and the training signal ceiling of model-only RL. Actionable insights are provided for agent post-training data pipeline design and closed-loop optimization, while the composable harness formalization lays groundwork for standardized agent engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: HarnessX is a unified harness foundry with three core modules: 1) Composable harness: The harness is formalized as a first-class typed object, assembled from typed primitives (processors spanning context, tools, skills, control, memory) via a substitution algebra inserted at lifecycle hook points. A 9-dimensional taxonomy covers the full behavioral space, enabling type-safe component addition/removal and full decoupling. 2) AEGIS adaptive evolution engine: Harness adaptation is framed as a learning problem over symbolic artifacts (prompts, tools, memory, control policies). A four-stage pipeline (Digester for trace compression, Planner for adaptation planning, Evolver for candidate generation, Critic for assessment) combined with full trace observability addresses RL-aligned risks including reward hacking, catastrophic forgetting, and under-exploration. An optional variant-isolation strategy eliminates cross-task interference on heterogeneous benchmarks. 3) Harness-model co-evolution: A shared replay buffer enables interleaved harness evolution and model GRPO training, allowing the model to internalize strategies from successive harness versions to form a closed optimization loop.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover 5 benchmarks (GAIA, ALFWorld, WebShop, \(\tau^3\)-Bench, SWE-bench Verified), 3 task agent families (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, Qwen3.5-9B) with up to 15 evolution rounds. 14 of 15 model-benchmark configurations show improvement, with an average absolute gain of +14.5% and a maximum of +44.0% (Qwen3.5-9B on ALFWorld). Gains follow an inverse-scaling pattern: weaker baseline models benefit more from harness evolution. On heterogeneous GAIA, single-harness evolution stagnates; variant isolation restores a stable +13.6% gain without degradation over 15 rounds. Co-evolution delivers an additional +4.7% gain over harness-only optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming: start with the three core flaws of existing harnesses in Section 1, core composable harness design in Section 3, AEGIS four-stage evolution pipeline in Section 4, and key experimental results in Section 6 (especially inverse-scaling patterns and co-evolution gains); estimated reading time 20-25 minutes. For implementation details, explore typed primitives and substitution algebra in Section 3; for training loop design, focus on the co-evolution mechanism in Section 5.

recommendation.zh: 轨迹驱动脚手架自演化的闭环设计有参考价值，重点看§3的AEGIS演化机制与§4的跨基准增益拆解。
recommendation.en: The closed-loop trace-driven harness evolution design is worth referencing; focus on §3 for the AEGIS mechanism and §4 for cross-benefit breakdown.

paper.title: Communication Policy Evolution for Proactive LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents have rapidly evolved into autonomous systems, yet a persistent information gap remains between users and agents: communication is costly, while users' identical preferences further limit information exchange. To investigate how agents should communicate across modalities, this paper formalizes Communication Policy, establishes textual and UI-based policies, and then evaluates communication policies across diverse environments, personas, and model combinations. Building information asy

summary.core_problem: LLM Agent与用户/规划器之间存在信息不对称：沟通有成本，用户偏好重复，缺乏跨模态的主动沟通策略优化框架。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次形式化Agent沟通策略，对比文本与结构化UI两种通道，并提出自演化框架优化沟通策略。
summary.technical_approach: 1)形式化Communication Policy，定义文本与UI两类沟通策略；2)在User-Agent与Planner-Executor两种信息不对称场景下评测；3)提出CPE自演化框架，用历史交互轨迹迭代优化沟通策略。
summary.experiments: 跨多环境、用户画像、模型组合的实验显示：文本交互提升任务完成率，结构化UI提升响应质量与画像一致性；混合方法兼具两者优势，CPE进一步提升策略表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Information asymmetry exists between LLM agents and users/planners: communication is costly, user preferences are repetitive, and there lacks a framework for optimizing proactive cross-modal communication policies.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation; formalizes agent communication policy, compares textual vs structured UI channels, and proposes a self-evolution framework for policy refinement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes Communication Policy with textual and UI-based variants, evaluates in User-Agent and Planner-Executor asymmetric settings, and introduces Communication Policy Evolution (CPE) to iteratively refine policies from historical interaction trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments across environments, personas, and model combinations show text interaction improves task performance while structured UI boosts response quality and persona compliance; the hybrid method combines both strengths, and CPE further enhances policy outcomes.

recommendation.zh: 属于Agent交互策略的细分方向增量工作，了解文本与UI通道的互补结论即可，无需深入。
recommendation.en: Incremental work on agent interaction strategy; only note the complementary strengths of text vs UI channels, no deep dive needed.

paper.title: Ouroboros-Spatial: Closing the Data-Model Loop for Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches largely rely on large-scale, statically curated datasets, where all training samples are treated uniformly regardless of the model's evolving capabilities. This static paradigm is inherently data-inefficient: training capacity is often spent on samples that are either trivial or overly difficult for the model at its current stage. To address this limitation, we propose Ouroboros-Spa

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在空间推理任务中，静态训练数据导致的数据效率低下问题。
summary.importance: 提出了一种自演化的训练框架，通过模型自我生成和筛选数据，动态调整训练难度，提升了空间推理能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Ouroboros-Spatial 框架，模型扮演 proposer 和 solver 两个角色。Proposer 利用 3D 场景元数据和视频帧生成空间 QA 对及可执行代码获取 ground truth；Solver 在接受的样本上微调，其预测置信度作为难度信号反馈给 Proposer，指导下一轮生成更具挑战性的数据。
summary.experiments: 在空间推理任务上验证了该自演化框架的有效性。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自北京大学和上海人工智能实验室。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the data inefficiency in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for spatial reasoning caused by static training datasets.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a self-evolving training framework that dynamically adjusts training difficulty through model self-generation and filtering, improving spatial reasoning capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Ouroboros-Spatial framework, where the model acts as both a proposer and a solver. The proposer generates spatial QA pairs and executable code for ground truth from 3D scene metadata and video frames. The solver is fine-tuned on accepted samples, and its prediction confidence serves as a difficulty signal fed back to the proposer to guide the generation of more challenging data in the next iteration.
summary_en.experiments: Validated the effectiveness of the self-evolving framework on spatial reasoning tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Peking University and Shanghai AI Laboratory.

recommendation.zh: 将 self-play/self-evolution 范式引入 VLM 空间推理数据的合成与筛选，作为 post-train 数据合成的参考，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Introduces the self-play/self-evolution paradigm to VLM spatial reasoning data synthesis and filtering; useful as a reference for post-train data synthesis, skip the main text.

paper.title: INFUSER: Influence-Guided Self-Evolution Improves Reasoning
paper.abstract: Self-evolution offers a scalable path to stronger reasoning: a pretrained language model improves itself with only minimal external supervision. Yet existing methods either depend on extensively curated or teacher-generated training data, or, when the generator runs unsupervised, reward it by a difficulty heuristic that need not improve the solver. We introduce INFUSER, an iterative co-training framework with two co-evolving roles: a Generator that drafts questions and reference golden answers f

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM自演进方法要么依赖大量人工/教师生成的训练数据，要么在无监督生成时用困难度启发式奖励generator，而困难度不一定真正提升solver。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出influence-guided自演进框架INFUSER，首次使用optimizer-aware influence score来奖励数据generator，使生成的问题真正有助于改进solver；同时提出DuGRPO dual-normalization适配连续噪声奖励信号。
summary.technical_approach: 两角色协同训练框架：Generator从非结构化文档中生成问题和参考答案；Solver通过标准正确性奖励在生成数据上训练。Generator的奖励信号是optimizer-aware influence score——衡量每个生成问题是否真正改善solver在目标分布上的表现。针对连续噪声的influence score不适合标准GRPO，提出DuGRPO（dual-normalization GRPO）。
summary.experiments: 摘要被截断，完整实验结果未给出。核心创新在方法设计和理论基础。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括普林斯顿大学的Jose Blanchee（统计/ML知名学者）、Zhuoran Yang（普林斯顿/DeepMind）、Tianhao Wang（普林斯顿）。属于知名学术团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM self-evolution methods either rely on extensively curated/teacher-generated training data, or reward the generator by a difficulty heuristic that does not necessarily improve the solver when run unsupervised.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes INFUSER, an influence-guided self-evolution framework using optimizer-aware influence scores to reward the data generator such that generated questions actually improve the solver. Also proposes DuGRPO, a dual-normalization GRPO variant for continuous noisy reward signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-role co-training framework: Generator drafts questions and reference golden answers from unstructured documents; Solver improves by training on them with standard correctness rewards. The generator is rewarded by an optimizer-aware influence score measuring whether each question actually improves the solver on the target distribution. Proposes DuGRPO (dual-normalization GRPO) since standard GRPO is poorly suited for continuous noisy influence scores.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated, full experimental results not provided. Core innovation is in methodology and theoretical foundation.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Jose Blanchet (Princeton, prominent statistics/ML researcher), Zhuoran Yang (Princeton/DeepMind), and Tianhao Wang (Princeton). Work from a well-known academic group.

recommendation.zh: 自演进+influence function奖励数据生成是有理论深度的方向，与R1-Zero范式相关，但属于后训练数据合成，对基座预训练有间接启示。重点看influence score设计和DuGRPO部分。
recommendation.en: Self-evolution with influence-function reward for data generation is a theoretically grounded direction related to the R1-Zero paradigm, but belongs to post-training data synthesis; indirect relevance to pre-training. Focus on the influence score design and DuGRPO sections.

paper.title: Socratic-SWE: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Trace-Derived Agent Skills
paper.abstract: LLM-driven software engineering agents have become a central testbed for real-world language-model capability, yet their training remains limited by the availability of high-quality SWE tasks. Existing synthetic data methods typically create tasks through fixed mutation or bug-injection procedures, making the resulting distributions largely independent of the agent's own weaknesses and training progress. We introduce Socratic-SWE, a closed-loop self-evolution framework that reuses the agent's hi

summary.core_problem: 软件工程（SWE）智能体的训练受限于高质量任务数据的稀缺性约束，传统合成数据方法不感知智能体当前的能力边界，生成的任务分布与智能体的实际能力缺口不匹配；现有方法仅将训练轨迹用于奖励计算，后续直接丢弃，导致训练后期学习停滞。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发点：证明智能体自身的交互轨迹可转化为结构化技能库，用于动态生成匹配当前能力边界的训练任务，实现无外部标注的自进化，为SWE领域智能体的持续预训练与RL训练提供了闭环数据生成范式，也为长horizon任务的课程学习提供了可复用的轨迹利用思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Socratic-SWE三阶段闭环自进化框架：第一阶段从历史解题轨迹中提炼重复出现的失败模式与成功修复行为，构建智能体技能注册表来表征模型当前的能力边界；第二阶段以技能为约束，在真实代码仓库中生成针对性修复任务，经执行验证流水线过滤，再通过求解器梯度对齐奖励筛选出能带来有效参数更新的任务；第三阶段求解器在筛选后的任务上训练，产生新的轨迹进入下一轮迭代。与传统开环静态任务生成方法不同，该框架感知模型当前能力，动态调整任务分布适配智能体的进化过程。
summary.experiments: 在36k训练样本的固定预算下，Socratic-SWE在SWE-bench Verified上达到50.40%，比基础智能体高7.80个百分点，比SSR基线高3.40个百分点；在SWE-bench Lite、SWE-bench Pro、Terminal-Bench 2.0上均超过所有适配基线，3轮迭代后仍能持续提升，且能力可迁移到终端原生任务。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先查看Figure1的两种范式对比图，可快速理解核心差异。阅读引言部分的核心动机与框架概述，10分钟即可掌握核心思路。若需进一步了解，可阅读Section3的框架流程与Section4的核心实验结果，总阅读时间控制在30分钟以内。除非专门从事SWE智能体方向研究，无需深入技能蒸馏与任务生成的具体实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Software engineering (SWE) agent training is constrained by the scarcity of high-quality task data. Traditional synthetic data methods are agnostic to the agent's current capability boundary, leading to task distributions misaligned with the agent's actual capability gaps. Existing methods only use training traces for reward computation and discard them afterward, causing learning stagnation in late training stages.
summary_en.importance: It demonstrates that agent interaction traces can be converted into a structured skill library to dynamically generate training tasks matched to the current capability boundary, enabling annotation-free self-evolution. It provides a closed-loop data generation paradigm for continuous pretraining and RL training of SWE agents, and offers a reusable approach to trace utilization for long-horizon curriculum learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Socratic-SWE is a three-stage closed-loop self-evolution framework. First, it distills recurring failure modes and successful repair patterns from historical solving traces into an Agent Skill Registry to represent the model's current capability boundary. Second, it uses these skills as constraints to generate targeted repair tasks in real code repositories, filters candidates via an execution-based validation pipeline, and further selects tasks with a solver-gradient alignment reward that induces effective parameter updates. Third, the solver trains on the selected tasks and produces new traces for the next iteration. Unlike traditional open-loop static task synthesis, this framework is model-aware and dynamically adapts task distribution to the agent's evolving capability.
summary_en.experiments: Under a fixed budget of 36k training instances, Socratic-SWE reaches 50.40% on SWE-bench Verified, 7.80 percentage points higher than the base agent and 3.40 points higher than the SSR baseline. It outperforms all adapted baselines on SWE-bench Lite, SWE-bench Pro, and Terminal-Bench 2.0, showing sustained improvement across 3 iterations and transferability to terminal-native tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Figure 1 first to understand the core difference between traditional and the proposed paradigm. Read the introduction for core motivation and framework overview to grasp the key idea in around 10 minutes. Read Section 3 for framework workflow and Section 4 for core experimental results if needed, with total reading time within 30 minutes. Detailed implementation of skill distillation and task generation is not necessary unless working specifically on SWE agent research.

recommendation.zh: 别把它当 SWE 小活看，这其实是在试一种更像 online post-train 的数据闭环；先看 trace→skill 抽取和 alignment reward，若 setup 干净，值得在推理数据合成里复现。
recommendation.en: Do not dismiss it as a narrow SWE paper; it is really testing an online post-training data loop. Read the trace-to-skill extraction and the alignment reward first, and if the setup is clean, it is worth reproducing for reasoning-data synthesis.

paper.title: OpenSkill: Open-World Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Self-evolving agents requires adaptation after deployment, but existing approaches assume a usable learning loop, such as curated skills, successful trajectories, or verifier signals. Real open-world deployments may provide none of these, offering only a task prompt. In this work, we study open-world self-evolution, where an agent must build both its skills and its own verification signals from scratch, using open-world resources but no target-task supervision. We propose OpenSkill, a framework

summary.core_problem: 现有自进化agent依赖 curated 技能、成功轨迹或外部验证信号，无法在无任何目标任务监督的开放世界场景下自适应。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出完全无目标任务监督的开放世界自进化框架，利用公开资源构建技能库和自监督验证环境。
summary.technical_approach: OpenSkill框架分三步：从文档、代码仓库、网络获取接地知识与验证锚点，合成可迁移技能，基于锚点构建的虚拟任务自监督优化技能，全程不使用目标任务标注。
summary.experiments: 在3个基准、2个目标任务上验证了自进化效果，无需目标任务监督即可获得显著性能提升。
summary.authors_note: 团队覆盖学术界与工业界研究机构，Philip S. Yu为知名数据科学与AI领域学者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing self-evolving agents rely on curated skills, successful trajectories, or external verification signals, and cannot adapt in open-world settings without any target-task supervision.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first open-world self-evolution framework that requires no target-task supervision, using public resources to build skill libraries and self-supervised verification environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The OpenSkill framework has three steps: acquire grounded knowledge and verification anchors from documentation, repositories, and the web; synthesize transferable skills; refine skills via self-supervised virtual tasks built on anchors, with no target-task labels used throughout the process.
summary_en.experiments: Validated self-evolution performance across 3 benchmarks and 2 target tasks, achieving significant performance gains without target-task supervision.
summary_en.authors_note: The team includes researchers from academia and industry, with Philip S. Yu as a prominent scholar in data science and AI.

recommendation.zh: 开放世界无监督自进化agent的探索性工作，思路新颖但验证场景有限，仅做前沿方向跟踪。
recommendation.en: This exploratory work on unsupervised open-world agent self-evolution is useful for frontier direction tracking but has limited validation scope.

paper.title: SkillPyramid: A Hierarchical Skill Consolidation Framework for Self-Evolving Agents
paper.abstract: Recent AI agents can flexibly invoke skills to solve complex tasks, but their long-term improvement is fundamentally constrained by a lack of systematic skill construction, accumulation, and transfer. In particular, without a unified framework for skill consolidation, agents tend to redundantly construct similar capabilities across different tasks, are unable to effectively transform experience into reusable assets, and struggle to generalize task-specific skills to novel scenarios. To address t

summary.core_problem: 现有 AI Agent 缺乏系统的技能构建、积累和迁移机制，导致在不同任务中重复构建相似能力，难以泛化到新场景。
summary.importance: 提出了一个层次化的技能巩固框架，使 Agent 能够重用现有技能经验，实现更广泛的任务泛化和自我进化。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillPyramid 框架，基于层次化技能拓扑运行，引入自我进化机制，使 Agent 能够在任务执行期间组合、验证和整合新技能。
summary.experiments: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上跨四个骨干模型进行实验，平均奖励大幅增加 38.0%。
summary.authors_note: 中科院自动化所、上海人工智能实验室等机构合作。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing AI agents lack systematic skill construction, accumulation, and transfer, leading to redundant capability building across tasks and poor generalization to novel scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a hierarchical skill consolidation framework enabling agents to reuse existing skill experience for broader task generalization and self-evolution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces SkillPyramid, operating on a hierarchical skill topology, with a self-evolution mechanism for agents to compose, validate, and incorporate new skills during task execution.

paper.title: On the Generalization Gap in Self-Evolving Language Model Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent work suggests that large language models (LLMs) can improve through self-evolution (SE), using supervision signals generated by the model itself. In this work, we ask: under a strict closed-loop setup, where the self-evolution algorithm has access only to an unlabeled prompt set and a base model, how close can internally generated supervision come to oracle-supervised training? summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“自进化能不能提升”，而是一个更尖锐的问题：在严格 closed-loop 设定下，模型只能拿到未标注 prompt 集和它自己，所有解答、验证、反馈、偏好标签都必须由模型内部产生时，这类内部监督距离 oracle 监督训练还有多远。作者把问题收得很窄，目的不是追求最好成绩，而是隔离“纯内部信号”本身的上限与缺口。全文围绕一个核心张力展开：一方面，self-evolution 在经验上常常能带来提升；另一方面，合成数据学习、无外部校验的 RL、以及自举式监督都存在已知退化风险。作者因此把重点放在 generalization gap，尤其是 easy-to-hard 泛化缺口：模型是否真的学到了可迁移的推理能力，还是只是在自生成分布上做了局部修补。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口研究，这篇文章的价值在于它给“纯自举监督”画了一条更清楚的边界。很多近期工作把 self-reward、self-verification、self-revision、online RL with intrinsic reward 混在一起讨论，容易让人高估内部监督的能力。这里作者用统一 offline 框架，把几类代表性 SE 方法放到同一坐标系下比较，并且始终拿 oracle preference optimization 作为参照。结论很稳：内部监督确实能持续带来增益，而且更强结构化信号通常更好；但即便在相对干净、可控、可验证的逻辑推理环境里，仍然存在稳定的 8–13 个点准确率缺口。这个结论对基座研究有两层含义。第一，若想把 RL 或 self-improvement 反哺到 pretrain，监督信号质量仍是主瓶颈，不能把“模型能给自己打分”直接等同于“模型能给自己提供足够好的学习信号”。第二，训练范式设计上，提升内部 verifier 质量、反馈结构和课程组织，可能比单纯增加 rollout 或在线交互更关键，因为瓶颈更像是信号保真度，而不是训练形式本身。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者没有再提一个新算法，而是把多种 SE 策略统一成 generator–verifier 框架下的离线偏好学习问题。基础流程是：给定未标注 prompt，基座模型先生成候选解；再由同一个模型或其派生流程产生验证、反馈或修订信号；最后把这些内部信号转成 preference data，对模型做离线训练。全文重点分析四类策略。

第一类是 single-round verification。模型对同一题生成多个候选答案，再用内部 verifier 对答案进行打分或二元判断，构造 chosen/rejected 对。这对应最直接的 generate-then-rank 范式，优点是便宜、实现简单，缺点是 verifier 噪声直接决定训练上限。

第二类是 multi-turn revision with feedback。这里不是只给一个“对/错”标签，而是让模型先批改，再给自然语言反馈，再据此修订答案。作者发现这种 richer feedback 比单轮验证更有效，因为它把稀疏偏好信号变成了带方向性的误差描述，训练时模型学到的不只是“哪个答案更好”，还有“为什么错、该往哪里改”。这点对 reasoning 很关键，因为推理错误往往不是表面格式问题，而是中间约束传播出错。

第三类是 iterative training。作者把离线 SE 做成多轮：先用当前模型生成监督并训练，再用更新后的模型重新生成数据继续训练。这个设定接近很多 self-training / self-rewarding 工作的实际流程。全文的一个重要观察是，迭代确实能继续抬升性能，但收益递减明显，而且如果 verifier 质量没有同步提升，误差会被反复固化，难以逼近 oracle。

第四类是 curriculum learning。Knights-and-Knaves 任务天然有难度参数，作者按人数或复杂度从易到难组织训练。课程学习的作用不是简单“先学简单题”，而是减少早期内部监督的噪声：在简单样本上，模型自验证和自修订更可靠，因此先在高置信度区域建立推理模板，再迁移到更难样本。作者把它视为提升内部监督有效性的一个间接手段，而不是独立于监督质量之外的技巧。

训练目标上，全文核心比较对象是 oracle preference optimization。也就是说，作者并不是拿 SE 去和原始 base model 比就结束，而是始终问：如果同样做偏好优化，只是把偏好标签从“模型自己给”换成“真值导出的 oracle 给”，差距还有多大。这个设计很重要，因为它把问题从“SE 是否有用”转成“内部信号损失了多少可学习信息”。

任务选择上，Knights-and-Knaves 很合适。它有确定性唯一解，难度可控，污染风险低，而且能自然测 easy-to-hard generalization。相比 GSM8K 这类可能被训练数据覆盖的 benchmark，KK 更像一个干净的机制实验台。作者还补充了 OpenThoughts3 及其他下游 reasoning benchmark，用来检查结论是否只局限于逻辑谜题。
summary.experiments:
主实验最关键的数字很直接。Gemma 3 4B 在 Knights-and-Knaves 上的 base accuracy 为 31.0%。如果用 oracle preference signals 训练，平均准确率提升到 53.3%。而严格 closed-loop SE 下，四类方法分别达到：single-round verification 40.7%，multi-turn feedback 42.2%，iterative training 44.1%，curriculum learning 44.8%。也就是说，SE 相对 base model 的绝对提升大约在 9.7 到 13.8 个点之间，但距离 oracle 仍有约 8.5 到 12.6 个点缺口。这个 gap 在作者的叙述里不是偶然波动，而是多种 SE 设计下都持续存在的结构性差距。

全文还有两个实验观察值得注意。第一，随着 SE 信号结构变丰富，性能基本单调上升：单轮验证 < 多轮反馈 < 迭代训练 < 课程学习。这说明问题不在于“自监督完全没用”，而在于内部信号的信息密度和可靠性不足。第二，更大的模型从 richer feedback 中获益更明显。文中提到 12B 模型在 multi-turn feedback 下表现尤其好，说明当基座能力足够时，模型能更有效地利用自然语言反馈中的误差信息；但即便如此，仍未消除与 oracle 的差距。

在 OpenThoughts3 相关实验里，作者比较了离线偏好学习和更昂贵的在线方法。结论是，offline preference learning 往往能做到与在线方法相当，但总体增益并不大，某些情况下甚至会退化。这一点很重要，因为它削弱了一个常见直觉：只要把 self-evolution 做成 online RL，就会显著优于离线自训练。作者给出的证据更接近另一种解释——如果奖励或偏好本身来自同一模型且质量有限，online 形式并不会自动解决信号偏差问题。

消融层面，全文最有信息量的不是某个小模块，而是对监督质量来源的拆解。作者强调，要把 closed-loop SE 做到最好，关键是尽量从模型内部提取可靠 verifier signal。多轮反馈优于简单打分，课程学习优于直接混合难题，原因都可以归结为：它们提高了早期训练样本的标签可信度，或者让错误更容易被语言化、结构化地表达出来。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看引言和方法总览，抓住作者真正要比较的对象：不是 SE vs base，而是 SE vs oracle preference optimization。这个参照系决定了全文的解释方式。

然后重点看 Knights-and-Knaves 设定与 easy-to-hard protocol。这里决定了为什么实验能讨论 generalization gap，而不是只看训练集内自举增益。若时间有限，先把任务构造、难度参数、训练/测试划分方式看清楚，再读主结果表。

主结果部分建议按四类方法顺序读，不要跳着看。single-round verification 给出最朴素基线；multi-turn feedback 展示 richer internal supervision 的价值；iterative training 说明多轮自举的收益与边界；curriculum learning 则回答“能否通过数据组织改善内部监督质量”。这四步连起来，才能看清作者的论证链条。

精读时要特别关注几类图表：一是不同方法相对 oracle 的 gap；二是按难度分层的准确率变化；三是 larger model 在 feedback-rich 设定下的收益；四是 OpenThoughts3 上 offline 与 online 的对比。如果只看平均分，很容易误以为结论只是“SE 有点用”；真正有价值的是 gap 如何随监督结构、模型规模和任务难度变化。

值得深挖的点有三个。其一，oracle 与 internal verifier 的误差类型是否集中在某些推理步骤，这关系到能否用 process-level reward 或 latent verifier 缩小缺口。其二，课程学习的收益究竟来自 easier examples 本身，还是来自更高置信度的内部标签。其三，offline 与 online 接近，是否意味着很多 self-evolution 工作的关键不在 RL，而在 reward construction。若做后续研究，这三个问题都可以直接展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower and more useful question than “does self-evolution help?” Under a strict closed-loop setup, where the learner only has an unlabeled prompt set and a base model, and every solution, verification signal, feedback trace, and preference label must be generated internally, how close can self-generated supervision get to oracle-supervised training? The focus is not on maximizing benchmark numbers, but on measuring the generalization gap induced by relying on internal signals alone. The key issue is easy-to-hard transfer: whether self-evolution actually improves transferable reasoning, or mostly reinforces local patterns on the model’s own synthetic distribution.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and post-training interface research, the main contribution is a cleaner boundary on what pure self-bootstrapping can and cannot do. Recent work often mixes self-rewarding, self-verification, self-revision, and intrinsic-reward RL under one optimistic narrative. This paper separates them within a unified offline framework and keeps oracle preference optimization as the reference point throughout. The result is clear: internally generated supervision does improve reasoning, and more structured internal signals help more, but a persistent gap remains even in a clean, controllable, uniquely verifiable reasoning environment. On Knights-and-Knaves, that gap is roughly 8–13 accuracy points relative to oracle supervision. This matters because it suggests the bottleneck is not merely whether one uses RL or self-training, but the fidelity of the learning signal. If one wants self-improvement to feed back into pretraining or continual training, verifier quality and feedback structure remain central constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper does not introduce a new training algorithm. Instead, it casts several representative self-evolution strategies into a common generator–verifier pipeline with offline preference learning. Starting from unlabeled prompts, the base model generates candidate solutions; the same model, or a procedure built from it, then produces verification judgments, feedback, or revisions; these internal signals are converted into preference data for training.

The first strategy is single-round verification. The model samples multiple candidate answers and uses an internal verifier to score or classify them, producing chosen/rejected pairs. This is the simplest generate-then-rank setup. It is cheap and easy to implement, but its ceiling is tightly coupled to verifier noise.

The second strategy is multi-turn revision with feedback. Instead of only assigning a scalar or binary judgment, the model critiques an answer, provides natural-language feedback, and then revises the solution. This richer signal matters because it turns sparse preference supervision into directional error information. For reasoning tasks, that is often more useful than a bare preference label, since many failures come from incorrect intermediate constraint propagation rather than surface-level formatting issues.

The third strategy is iterative training. The authors repeat the offline self-evolution cycle: generate internal supervision with the current model, train on it, then regenerate data with the updated model and continue. This mirrors practical self-training and self-rewarding loops. The paper shows that iteration helps, but with diminishing returns, and that errors can be repeatedly reinforced if verifier quality does not improve in parallel.

The fourth strategy is curriculum learning. Knights-and-Knaves provides a natural difficulty axis, so the authors train from easier to harder instances. The role of curriculum here is not just standard optimization smoothing. It improves the effective quality of internal supervision, because self-verification and self-revision are more reliable on easier examples. The model can first stabilize reasoning patterns in a higher-confidence regime before moving to harder cases.

The central comparison is against oracle preference optimization. This is an important design choice. The question is not whether self-evolution beats the base model, but how much learnable information is lost when preference labels come from the model itself rather than from ground-truth-derived oracle signals.

The task choice is also deliberate. Knights-and-Knaves offers deterministic unique solutions, controllable difficulty, and low contamination risk, making it a good testbed for studying generalization rather than benchmark memorization. The paper also includes experiments on OpenThoughts3 and downstream reasoning benchmarks to test whether the conclusions extend beyond logic puzzles.
summary_en.experiments:
The main numbers are straightforward and informative. On Knights-and-Knaves, Gemma 3 4B starts at 31.0% average accuracy. Oracle preference supervision raises this to 53.3%. Under strict closed-loop self-evolution, single-round verification reaches 40.7%, multi-turn feedback 42.2%, iterative training 44.1%, and curriculum learning 44.8%. So self-evolution gives meaningful gains over the base model, roughly +9.7 to +13.8 points, but still leaves a stable gap of about 8.5 to 12.6 points relative to oracle supervision.

Two experimental patterns matter. First, performance improves roughly monotonically as the internal supervision becomes more structured: single-round verification < multi-turn feedback < iterative training < curriculum. This suggests the issue is not that self-generated supervision is useless, but that its information content and reliability are limited. Second, larger models benefit more from richer feedback. The paper notes that a 12B model gains especially strongly from multi-turn feedback, which is consistent with the idea that stronger base models can better exploit natural-language critiques. Even then, the oracle gap remains.

The OpenThoughts3 experiments add another useful point. Offline preference learning performs on par with more expensive online methods, but the gains are modest and can even become negative in some settings. This weakens the common assumption that moving self-evolution into online RL automatically solves the problem. If the reward or preference signal is still generated by the same model and remains noisy, the online format alone does not remove the supervision bottleneck.

The most informative ablation theme is supervision quality. Multi-turn feedback beats simple verification because it exposes error structure. Curriculum helps because it increases label reliability early in training. The paper’s empirical story is consistent throughout: better internal signal extraction helps, but does not close the gap to oracle supervision.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the unified framing. The most important conceptual move is that the paper compares self-evolution not only against the base model, but against oracle preference optimization. That reference point determines how all later results should be interpreted.

Then read the Knights-and-Knaves setup carefully, especially the easy-to-hard protocol. This is what makes the paper about generalization gap rather than just synthetic-data self-training gains. If time is limited, make sure to understand the task construction, the difficulty parameter, and the train/test split before looking at the main tables.

Read the four methods in order. Single-round verification establishes the minimal baseline. Multi-turn feedback shows the value of richer internal supervision. Iterative training tests whether repeated bootstrapping compounds gains. Curriculum learning asks whether data ordering can improve the effective quality of internal labels. The argument is cumulative, so reading them sequentially helps.

Pay special attention to figures and tables that show: the gap to oracle supervision, performance by difficulty level, the effect of larger models under feedback-rich settings, and the offline-versus-online comparison on OpenThoughts3. Looking only at average scores would miss the main point.

Three follow-up questions are worth thinking about. First, where exactly does the internal verifier diverge from oracle supervision at the error-type level? Second, is curriculum helping because examples are easier, or because internal labels are more trustworthy on those examples? Third, if offline and online methods are similar here, does that imply the key research problem is reward construction rather than RL machinery? Those are the parts most likely to inform future work.

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是自进化 Agent 评测中的两个混淆：任务分数提升并不能说明模型真的会反思；Agent 自己跑出来的失败轨迹也不可控，难以定位某一类失败经验是否被正确吸收。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 后的 Agent 能力评测有参考价值。它把“反思能力”和“演化算法有效性”拆开评估，这一点比只看最终任务成功率更干净。对基座研究员的启发在于：长期交互能力不只依赖模型能力，还依赖失败经验的表示、检索和迁移；这些信号未来也可能反哺 SFT/RL 数据构造。
summary.technical_approach: BenchTrace 构建了一个 snapshot-reflection 数据集。snapshot 是 Agent 生成的一条完整任务轨迹，包含交互过程和最终结果；reflection 是人工或结构化标注的失败分析，按 detection、localization、diagnosis 三层组织。Detection 判断轨迹中是否有值得修正的失败；localization 标出失败发生在哪些步骤；diagnosis 给出失败类型和原因。失败分类进一步分为 system failure、strategy failure、operation failure。system failure 主要是格式或语法错误；strategy failure 是跨多步的规划问题，例如在环境中反复循环；operation failure 是局部执行错误，例如忽略环境反馈。评测分成两部分：Reflection Evaluation 用 QA 任务直接测试基座模型是否能识别和诊断失败；Evolution Evaluation 给 Agent 输入受控的 snapshot 序列，模拟自进化过程，再看后续 episode 中是否避免同类错误。论文还提出 failure avoidance rate，用来衡量失败经验是否转化为行为层面的避免能力。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 1,821 条带反思标注的 episode，覆盖 6 类任务。关键实验结论有两个：第一，现有自进化 Agent 会在噪声 episode 增多时遗忘早期教训，说明外部记忆或反思记录不是简单累积即可；第二，Agent 往往只能在相近上下文中复用反思，跨任务或跨情境迁移时可能出现负迁移。给定材料中没有完整列出各模型的具体分数、各任务分布和 FAR 数值，因此不宜补充未确认的定量结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 interpretability 和 controllability 的定义，再看 benchmark 设计部分的 snapshot、reflection、failure class/mode/instance。若关注 Agent 记忆和自进化，可重点看 Evolution Evaluation 的 controlled snapshot sequence 设计，以及 failure avoidance rate 的计算方式。实验部分建议看它如何诊断遗忘和负迁移，这比排行榜分数更有信息量。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets a specific evaluation gap in self-evolving LLM agents: task-score improvement does not tell whether the model can diagnose failures, and agent-generated experience is not controlled enough to isolate particular failure patterns.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation contribution rather than a pretraining contribution. Its useful point for foundation-model research is the separation between reflection quality and evolution effectiveness. That separation matters for post-training and agent training pipelines, where failure traces, memory, and behavioral transfer are often mixed into one final task metric.
summary_en.technical_approach: BenchTrace is built around a snapshot-reflection dataset. A snapshot is a full agent episode with the interaction trajectory and final outcome. A reflection is a structured failure annotation organized into three levels: detection, localization, and diagnosis. Detection asks whether the episode contains a meaningful failure; localization identifies the failed steps; diagnosis classifies the failure mode and explains the cause. The taxonomy separates system failures, strategy failures, and operation failures. The benchmark then defines two evaluations. Reflection Evaluation directly probes whether an LLM can identify and explain failures through hierarchical QA tasks. Evolution Evaluation feeds agents controlled sequences of past snapshots, simulates a self-evolution setting, and tests whether the agent avoids similar mistakes in later episodes. The proposed failure avoidance rate measures whether past failure experience changes behavior, not just whether the agent can verbalize a lesson.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 1,821 annotated episodes across six tasks. The main empirical findings are diagnostic: current self-evolving agents tend to forget early lessons as noisy episodes accumulate, and their reflections often fail to generalize beyond the original context, sometimes causing negative transfer. The provided material does not include full per-model scores, task-level breakdowns, or exact FAR numbers, so those details should be checked in the tables before using the benchmark for model comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the motivation around interpretability and controllability first, then the definitions of snapshot, reflection, failure class, failure mode, and failure instance. For agent-memory work, focus on the controlled evolution setup and the failure avoidance rate. The most useful experimental part is the analysis of forgetting and negative transfer, rather than the raw task scores.

paper.title: Confidence-Orchestrated Self-Evolution against Uncertain LLM Feedback
paper.abstract: Self-evolving large language models (LLMs) learn by generating their own training tasks and solutions, reducing reliance on human-curated supervision. However, in many reasoning domains, the model must also validate generated tasks and judge generated answers to obtain training signals. This creates a training-signal challenge: erroneous self-judgments become erroneous gradient updates. Existing approaches either rely on external verifiers, which limits generality, or treat noisy self-generated

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是自演化 LLM 中的训练信号噪声问题。模型自己生成题目、验证题目、解答题目、判断答案时，Validator 和 Judge 的错误反馈会直接变成奖励、过滤条件或 replay 优先级，进而形成错误梯度。论文的核心问题不是如何生成更多自训练数据，而是如何降低不确定反馈对策略更新的影响。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于，它把自生成反馈从“可用或不可用”的二值问题，改写成 per-sample training control 问题。这个视角适合连接 self-training、RLVR、continual pretrain 和后训练数据闭环。贡献量级属于方法型增量，但问题定义比较准确：当 verifier 不能外置、任务又不可执行验证时，LLM-as-judge 的不确定性需要进入优化过程，而不是只在数据过滤阶段处理。
summary.technical_approach: COSE 使用同一个 backbone，通过 prompt 扮演 Proposer、Validator、Solver、Judge 四个角色。Proposer 生成候选题，Validator 给出题目质量分数 v(q) 和置信度 cV(q)；Solver 生成答案，Judge 给出正确性分数 p(q,a) 和置信度 cJ(q,a)。置信度来自生成反馈时 token-level 分布的熵，熵越低表示模型对该判断越确定。训练时只优化 Proposer 和 Solver，Validator 与 Judge 只作为 inference-time feedback module 提供分数和置信度。COSE 在两处使用置信度：一是 confidence-weighted PPO，让低置信反馈对应的样本在 PPO 更新中权重更小；二是 confidence-prioritized replay，让 replay buffer 更偏向有效、判断较确定、且处在当前 Solver 能力边界附近的问题。它与依赖外部 verifier 的路线不同，目标是保留任务通用性；也不同于直接把自判结果当监督信号，COSE 不假设自判一定正确，而是控制其训练影响。
summary.experiments: 论文在 19 个 held-out benchmarks 和 4 个 Qwen/Llama backbone 上评估 COSE。报告结果显示，COSE 相比 base model 有稳定提升，并且相对已有 self-evolving baseline 通常更好或相当。实验设置覆盖不同模型族，说明方法不是只依赖某一个 backbone 的校准特性。关键消融应关注两类机制的独立贡献：confidence-weighted PPO 是否降低错误反馈造成的更新污染，confidence-prioritized replay 是否改善训练样本分布。文中给出的框架数字包括 19 个评测集、4 个 Qwen/Llama backbone；提供内容中未出现具体逐项分数和提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看 Introduction 和 Method。Introduction 对“自生成反馈是优化问题”讲得比较清楚，适合判断这篇工作的研究定位。Method 重点看四角色共享 backbone 的训练边界、Validator/Judge 为什么不直接优化、置信度如何从 token entropy 转成 PPO 权重和 replay 优先级。实验部分建议快速扫主表和消融表，确认提升是否来自置信度控制，而不是简单的数据量或 replay 策略变化。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses noisy training signals in self-evolving LLMs. In this setting, the model proposes tasks, validates them, solves them, and judges its own answers. Errors from the Validator or Judge are not just evaluation errors; they become rewards, filters, replay priorities, and ultimately gradient updates. The central question is how to limit the optimization impact of uncertain LLM-generated feedback.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea for pretraining and post-training research is to treat self-generated feedback as a per-sample training-control signal rather than a binary accept-or-reject label. This is relevant to self-training, RL with weak verifiers, continual training loops, and synthetic reasoning data pipelines. The contribution is method-level rather than a new training paradigm, but the problem framing is sound: when external verifiers are unavailable, uncertainty in LLM-as-judge feedback has to be handled inside the optimization loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: COSE uses one shared backbone prompted into four roles: Proposer, Validator, Solver, and Judge. The Proposer generates candidate reasoning questions. The Validator assigns a quality score v(q) and a confidence score cV(q). The Solver answers accepted questions. The Judge assigns a correctness score p(q,a) and a confidence score cJ(q,a). Confidence is estimated from the entropy of the token-level output distribution when the Validator or Judge produces feedback. Low entropy is treated as higher confidence. Only Proposer and Solver trajectories receive optimization losses; Validator and Judge are used as inference-time feedback modules. COSE uses confidence in two places: confidence-weighted PPO, which downweights uncertain feedback during policy updates, and confidence-prioritized replay, which samples more from questions that are valid, confidently judged, and close to the Solver’s current capability boundary. This differs from external-verifier methods by keeping the loop more general, and differs from naive self-training by not treating all self-judgments as equally reliable supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates COSE on 19 held-out benchmarks and four Qwen/Llama backbones. The reported trend is consistent improvement over the base models, with performance better than or competitive with prior self-evolving baselines. The multi-backbone setup is important because entropy-based confidence can be model-calibration dependent. The key experimental evidence to inspect is the ablation of confidence-weighted PPO and confidence-prioritized replay, since these determine whether the gain comes from uncertainty-aware optimization rather than from additional generated data alone. The provided content specifies the number of benchmarks and model families, but does not expose detailed per-benchmark scores or exact improvement margins.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction and Method first. The Introduction gives the cleanest statement of why noisy self-feedback is an optimization bottleneck. In the Method, focus on the four-role shared-backbone setup, the decision to optimize only Proposer and Solver, the entropy-based confidence estimate, and how confidence enters PPO and replay. For experiments, check the main result table and ablations to see whether both confidence mechanisms are necessary. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 探讨了 RL 阶段如何利用模型自身 confidence 来 reweight PPO 更新，缓解自我评估的噪声问题，对 post-training 数据合成和 RL 训练有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Explores using intrinsic confidence to reweight PPO updates during self-evolution, mitigating noisy self-evaluation; offers insights for post-training data synthesis and RL.

paper.title: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence
paper.abstract: We introduce the MiniMax-M2 series, a family of Mixture-of-Experts language models built around the principle that mini activations can unleash maximum real-world intelligence. The flagship M2 contains 229.9B total parameters with only 9.8B activated per token. Designed end-to-end for agentic deployment, the M2 series rests on three components: (i) agent-driven data pipelines producing large-scale, verifiable trajectories across agentic coding and agentic cowork, each grounded in an executable w

summary.core_problem: MiniMax-M2 系列试图解决一个很现实的问题：长上下文 agent 任务需要强模型能力，但线上训练和推理成本不能按稠密大模型的方式增长。论文把问题拆成两层：预训练阶段用低激活量 MoE 扩大容量，后训练阶段用可验证的长轨迹 RL 构建真实 agent 能力。
summary.importance: 这篇对基座研究的价值较高。它不是单一模型报告，而是把 MoE 架构、长上下文预训练、MTP 推测解码、agent 数据管线、RL 系统和生产部署约束放在同一个设计闭环里。最值得关注的是两个点。第一，229.9B 总参数但每 token 只激活 9.8B，说明小激活量 MoE 仍可承载强 agent 能力，前提是路由、专家粒度和训练系统足够稳定。第二，论文把 post-train 的 reward 可信度和轨迹执行环境放到核心位置，说明 base model 潜力能否释放，不只取决于预训练 loss，也取决于后续 RL 信号是否可验证、是否贴近真实任务。
summary.technical_approach: M2 是 62 层 decoder-only Transformer，总参数 229.9B，每 token 激活 9.8B。隐藏维度为 3072，词表大小 200,064，预训练 token 数为 29.2T，原生上下文长度 192K。注意力采用全层 full attention，而不是混合注意力；每层使用 GQA，48 个 query heads、8 个 key-value heads，并使用 RoPE。FFN 部分采用 MoE，包含 256 个细粒度专家，每 token 激活 8 个专家。细粒度专家提高了路由组合多样性，也降低单个专家负载波动。路由使用 sigmoid gating 和可学习的 expert-specific bias，以改善负载均衡，并减少对 auxiliary load-balancing loss 的依赖。预训练除 next-token prediction 外加入 MTP 模块；继续预训练时通过权重复制扩展该模块，使其在推理阶段可作为多步 speculative decoding 的 draft path。后训练部分围绕 agent-native RL 展开。数据管线覆盖 agentic coding、agentic cowork、reasoning 和 general knowledge，每个任务尽量配套静态或运行时环境、可验证 reward 或可信反馈。Forge 系统把 training、inference 和 agent scaffold 解耦，支持 white-box 和 API-only black-box agent 进入同一训练循环。系统侧用 windowed-FIFO 调度吸收长轨迹长度差异，用 prefix-tree merging 合并共享前缀，用推理 kernel 和部署栈协同降低 RL rollout 成本。M2.7 还展示了早期自我演化流程：模型可以 triage 失败训练、修改 agent scaffold，并在 ML engineering 任务上做多轮自改进评测。
summary.experiments: 关键数字集中在模型规模、训练规模和 agent benchmark。M2 预训练使用 29.2T tokens，模型为 229.9B 总参数、9.8B 激活参数、192K 原生上下文。M2.7 在 agentic coding 上达到 SWE-bench Pro 56.2、SWE-bench Multilingual 76.5、Multi-SWE-bench 52.7、Terminal-Bench 2.0 57.0。在 agentic cowork 上达到 MM Claw 62.7、BrowseComp 77.8、GDPval-AA 50.0、Toolathlon 46.3。在 reasoning 和 knowledge 上，AIME 2026 为 94.2，GPQA-Diamond 为 89.8。论文还强调 M2 到 M2.5 再到 M2.7 的系列内增益，说明能力提升主要来自 agent 数据、reward 质量、RL 系统和自我改进流程的共同迭代。给定内容中没有展开所有架构消融的具体表格数字，但明确提到细粒度专家、sigmoid gating、full attention 和 MTP 都经过设计空间比较；这些消融应是精读时的重点。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看第 2 节预训练架构，重点关注 MoE 颗粒度、sigmoid gating、expert bias、full attention 取舍、MTP 如何同时服务训练和推理。再看 agent 数据管线和 Forge 系统部分，重点是 reward 如何定义、轨迹如何执行验证、长轨迹 RL 如何调度，以及 training-inference-agent 解耦带来的工程边界。最后看第 8 节 benchmark 和 M2/M2.5/M2.7 的系列内对比，不要只看最终分数，要看哪些能力来自 base architecture，哪些来自 RL-time scaling。值得深挖的点包括：9.8B 激活量下的专家容量是否足以覆盖长上下文 agent 任务；192K full attention 的训练和推理成本如何被系统吸收；MTP 作为预训练辅助目标和 speculative decoding draft path 是否存在目标不一致；可验证 reward 在 coding 与 cowork 任务中的质量差异。
summary.authors_note: MiniMax；给定内容未提供完整作者列表。背景上，这是一篇模型系列技术报告，覆盖预训练架构、长上下文 MoE、agent 数据、RL 系统和部署相关优化。

summary_en.core_problem: The MiniMax-M2 series addresses a practical scaling problem: long-horizon agentic workloads require strong model capability, but training and serving costs cannot grow like dense frontier models. The solution is split into two layers: use low-activation MoE pretraining to increase capacity under a small per-token compute budget, then use verifiable long-trajectory RL to build real agentic behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is highly relevant for foundation-model researchers because it connects architecture, pretraining scale, long context, MTP-based speculative decoding, agent data construction, RL infrastructure, and deployment constraints in one system. Two points matter most. First, a 229.9B-parameter model with only 9.8B activated parameters per token can still support strong agentic performance, if expert granularity, routing, and training stability are handled carefully. Second, the report treats reward credibility and executable environments as central ingredients, showing that the value of a base model is strongly mediated by the quality of post-training signals, not only by pretraining loss.
summary_en.technical_approach: M2 is a 62-layer decoder-only Transformer with 229.9B total parameters and 9.8B activated parameters per token. It uses a hidden size of 3,072, a vocabulary of 200,064 tokens, 29.2T pretraining tokens, and a native 192K context length. Attention is full attention in all layers rather than a hybrid pattern. It uses GQA with 48 query heads and 8 key-value heads, together with RoPE. The feed-forward blocks are MoE layers with 256 fine-grained experts and 8 activated experts per token. The fine-grained design increases routing combinatorics and reduces utilization variance. Routing uses sigmoid gating plus learnable expert-specific biases, improving load balance while reducing dependence on auxiliary load-balancing losses. The pretraining objective includes standard next-token prediction plus an MTP module. During continued pretraining, the MTP module is expanded through weight copying and later reused as a multi-step speculative-decoding draft path. The post-training stack is agent-native. Data pipelines cover agentic coding, agentic cowork, reasoning, and general knowledge, with static or runtime environments, verifiable rewards, or credible feedback. Forge decouples training, inference, and the agent scaffold, and supports both white-box and API-only black-box agents in one loop. It uses windowed-FIFO scheduling to handle trajectory-length variance, prefix-tree merging to share common prefixes, and inference kernels aligned with the serving stack to reduce rollout cost. M2.7 also shows an early self-evolution setup, where the model triages failed training runs, edits its own agent scaffold, and is evaluated through multi-round self-improvement on ML-engineering tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The key reported numbers include 29.2T pretraining tokens, 229.9B total parameters, 9.8B activated parameters, and a 192K native context window. On agentic coding, M2.7 scores 56.2 on SWE-bench Pro, 76.5 on SWE-bench Multilingual, 52.7 on Multi-SWE-bench, and 57.0 on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On agentic cowork, it reaches 62.7 on MM Claw, 77.8 on BrowseComp, 50.0 on GDPval-AA, and 46.3 on Toolathlon. On reasoning and knowledge, it reports 94.2 on AIME 2026 and 89.8 on GPQA-Diamond. The report emphasizes within-series progress from M2 to M2.5 to M2.7, attributing the gains to co-evolution of agent data, reward quality, RL infrastructure, and self-improvement. The provided content does not expose all ablation numbers, but it clearly identifies fine-grained experts, sigmoid gating, full attention, and MTP as design choices benchmarked against alternatives.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with the pretraining architecture section, especially expert granularity, sigmoid gating, expert bias, the choice of full attention, and the dual role of MTP in training and inference. Then read the agent data and Forge sections, focusing on reward definition, executable verification, long-trajectory scheduling, and the engineering boundary created by decoupling training, inference, and the agent. Finally, read the benchmark section and the M2/M2.5/M2.7 progression. The most useful questions are: how far 9.8B activated parameters can go for long-context agentic workloads; how the system absorbs the cost of 192K full attention; whether MTP as an auxiliary pretraining objective aligns cleanly with its use as a speculative draft path; and how reward reliability differs between coding and cowork tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: MiniMax; the provided content does not include the full author list. The work is a model-series technical report spanning pretraining architecture, long-context MoE, agent data pipelines, RL systems, and deployment-oriented optimization.

recommendation.zh: 这类报告会直接影响你对 pretrain↔RL 接口的设计：先看数据验证链路和 Forge 调度，指标先别太信，recipe 比分数更值钱。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on the pretrain↔RL interface: read the verifiable data pipeline and Forge scheduling first; trust the recipe more than the headline scores.

paper.title: AnE: Pushing the Reasoning Frontier of Multimodal LLMs via Anchor Evolution
paper.abstract: Post-training via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) is crucial for enhancing reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet existing paradigms often reach a performance bottleneck due to the limitations of static data. While current methods leverage self-reflection or self-evolution to push these boundaries, they still suffer from cognitive drift and hallucinated reasoning paths caused by low-quality synthetic data. To address these challenges, we propose A

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是多模态推理模型在后训练阶段很容易遇到的一个具体瓶颈：静态 SFT/RL 数据很快被模型吃干，后续提升缺少针对性；而纯自演化合成数据虽然能持续扩展难度，却容易把错误推理路径、幻觉知识和教师分布偏差一并放大。论文想解决的不是单次训练技巧，而是如何让后训练数据随着模型能力一起演化，同时又不把训练过程带偏。它把问题落在“失败前沿”上：先找出模型当前最容易出错、但又最有提升空间的区域，再用可验证的真实知识作为锚点去扩展训练样本，最后把外部提示逐步蒸馏成模型自身能力。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它虽然是多模态 post-train 工作，但核心关切其实是训练信号质量与数据闭环设计，这和预训练里的数据配比、数据清洗、持续训练中的分布漂移问题是同一类问题。第二，它给出了一种比“模型自己造数据再自己学”更稳的演化路线：用真实数据库检索到的 truth anchors 约束数据生成，再用 SFT+RL 分工完成能力注入与模板去除。这个思路对 reasoning continual training、mid-train curriculum、以及 RL 不能凭空创造新能力的讨论都有直接参考价值。贡献量级上，它更像一个扎实的训练框架与数据构造范式，而不是新的基础模型架构。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三个环节组成，而且三者是串起来的。第一步是 Failing-Frontier Discovery。作者不是直接在全量种子集上做扩充，而是先让当前模型对种子数据做多次 rollout，观察哪些题目稳定失败、哪些推理轨迹暴露出明显短板。随后再用教师模型对这些失败样本做诊断，抽取失败相关的关键词、知识点和提示信息。这样做的目的，是把后续数据构造对准模型当前能力边界，而不是泛泛增加训练量。

第二步是 Truth Anchor Expansion。这是全文最关键的设计。作者不信任闭环自生成数据的事实性和逻辑一致性，因此引入外部真实数据库，从失败样本对应的知识点出发检索“truth anchors”。这些 anchor 不是直接当答案，而是作为高保真参考，用来构造新的训练样本、补充背景知识、校正推理链中的事实节点。和常见 self-evolution 不同，这里数据扩展的约束来自外部可验证知识，而不是教师模型自由发挥。这样可以减少 synthetic QA 中常见的逻辑错配、答案漂移和越迭代越偏的问题。

第三步是 Scaffold-Stripping Mechanism。作者把教师提示显式写进训练样本，先形成 scaffold-augmented supervision，让模型在带脚手架的条件下学会正确推理路径；然后再通过 RL 去掉这些脚手架，让模型不依赖固定提示模板也能完成推理。这里的分工很清楚：SFT 负责把新知识和正确轨迹灌进去，RL 负责把外显提示内化成行为习惯。这个设计背后有一个明确判断：如果直接用 RL 从稀疏正确率奖励里学复杂多模态推理，信号太弱；如果只做 SFT，模型又容易记住模板而不是形成稳定能力。

从方法定位看，AnE 不是单纯的数据检索增强，也不是普通 teacher-student 蒸馏。它更像一个面向 reasoning frontier 的迭代式训练循环：失败诊断决定学什么，truth anchor 决定学的内容是否可信，scaffold stripping 决定能力能否脱离外部支架独立存在。
summary.experiments:
论文以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 为底座，在 8 个多模态推理 benchmark 上评测。文中给出的总结果是：相对 base model，AnE 多轮迭代后平均提升 10.3%。作者特别强调在 MathVision 和 EMMA 这类较难数据集上保持了领先表现，说明收益不只来自简单题或分布内题目。

从实验结构看，最值得注意的不是单个分数，而是“持续提升”这一点。作者把 AnE 和静态数据后训练、以及纯 self-evolution 路线做比较，结论是静态数据方法很快进入平台期，而 AnE 在多轮迭代中还能继续涨，说明 failing frontier 驱动的数据更新确实在不断对准新短板。另一组关键对比是 truth anchor 的作用：去掉真实锚点后，性能提升会变弱，而且更容易出现 reasoning drift，说明外部可验证知识不是锦上添花，而是闭环演化能否稳定的核心条件。

脚手架机制的消融也很重要。只做 scaffold SFT 而不做后续 RL，模型会更依赖提示格式，泛化和自由生成能力不足；只做 RL 而没有前面的 scaffold supervision，则很难稳定学到正确轨迹。两者结合时效果最好，和作者在引言里对 SFT 与 RL 分工的判断一致。

受限于给出的全文片段，部分 benchmark 的逐项数字、迭代轮数细节、以及各消融的精确幅度没有完全展开；但从正文描述可以确认，实验重点是验证三件事：一是相对静态数据的持续增益，二是相对纯合成演化的数据质量优势，三是 SFT 注入 + RL 内化这一训练分工的必要性。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只花一小时，优先看三处。第一是方法总览图和 Failing-Frontier Discovery 部分，理解作者如何定义“失败前沿”，以及为什么要用多次 rollout 而不是单次错误样本筛选。这里关系到整个框架是不是在做真正的 targeted training。第二是 Truth Anchor Expansion 的实现细节，重点看 anchor 的来源、检索条件、如何从 anchor 构造成新样本，以及它和教师生成内容各自承担什么角色。这里决定这篇工作的含金量。第三是 scaffold-stripping 的训练流程和消融表，判断 RL 到底是在提升正确率，还是在做模板去除与行为内化。

图表上建议重点看：总框架图、不同迭代轮次的性能曲线、truth anchor 与无 anchor 的对比、以及 scaffold/RL 相关消融。如果有案例分析，优先看失败样本如何被诊断、检索、再构造成训练数据，这能直接看出方法是否真的避免了 synthetic drift。

值得深挖的点有三个。其一，truth anchor 的质量上限由外部数据库覆盖率决定，这会不会把方法限制在可检索知识密集的任务上。其二，教师模型在失败诊断和提示生成中仍然扮演重要角色，教师偏差是否会通过 scaffold 间接注入。其三，这套框架能否迁移到纯文本 reasoning continual pretrain，或者更一般的 mid-training data refresh 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a concrete bottleneck in multimodal reasoning post-training: static SFT/RL datasets saturate quickly, while self-evolving synthetic data can keep expanding but often amplifies logical errors, hallucinated reasoning paths, and teacher-distribution mismatch. The real problem is not just data scarcity. It is how to keep training data adaptive to the model’s current failure frontier without letting the optimization loop drift away from reliable knowledge. AnE frames this as a closed-loop evolution problem: identify where the model currently fails, retrieve verified external anchors around those failures, and then convert teacher-guided reasoning into internalized capability.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining-oriented readers, the value is less about multimodal benchmark chasing and more about training-signal design. The paper is a useful case study in how data quality, adaptivity, and distribution alignment interact in iterative training. It also reinforces a view that has become increasingly important in reasoning work: SFT is better at injecting new patterns and knowledge, while RL is better at consolidating and de-scaffolding behavior. In that sense, AnE is relevant to continual pretraining, mid-training curriculum refresh, and any setting where synthetic data loops risk compounding model errors. The contribution is a practical training paradigm rather than a new base architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AnE consists of three tightly coupled stages.

First, Failing-Frontier Discovery. Instead of expanding data uniformly, the model is rolled out multiple times on a seed set to expose unstable or consistently failing regions. A teacher model then analyzes these failures and extracts failure-relevant keywords, hints, and diagnostic signals. This makes the next round of training target the model’s current capability boundary rather than a generic task distribution.

Second, Truth Anchor Expansion. This is the central idea. Rather than trusting synthetic QA pairs generated inside a self-evolution loop, the method retrieves verified samples from an external real-world database as truth anchors. These anchors are used as high-fidelity references for constructing new training examples, enriching missing knowledge, and correcting factual or logical nodes in reasoning chains. The key distinction from standard self-evolution is that data growth is constrained by externally grounded evidence, not only by teacher generations. That directly addresses cognitive drift and hallucinated trajectories.

Third, Scaffold-Stripping Mechanism. Teacher hints are first injected explicitly into training examples, producing scaffold-augmented supervision for SFT. This gives the student a guided path toward correct reasoning. RL is then used to remove the scaffolds, so the model learns to reproduce the behavior without depending on explicit templates or hints. The division of labor is deliberate: SFT introduces the reasoning pattern and missing knowledge; RL turns externally visible guidance into an internalized policy.

Conceptually, AnE is not just retrieval augmentation and not just distillation. It is an iterative reasoning-training loop where failure diagnosis decides what to learn, truth anchors decide what can be trusted, and scaffold stripping decides whether the learned behavior survives after the support is removed.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-7B as the base model and evaluate on eight multimodal reasoning benchmarks. The headline result reported in the paper is an average improvement of 10.3% over the base model after multiple AnE iterations. The paper also highlights strong performance on difficult benchmarks such as MathVision and EMMA.

The more interesting result is the shape of improvement over iterations. Static-data post-training reaches a plateau relatively early, while AnE continues to improve across rounds, which supports the claim that failure-frontier targeting keeps exposing useful new supervision. Another important comparison is the role of truth anchors. Removing the anchor mechanism weakens gains and makes the evolution loop more prone to reasoning drift, suggesting that verified external grounding is not optional but central to stability.

The scaffold mechanism is also tested through ablations. Scaffolded SFT without the RL stripping stage tends to leave the model dependent on prompt-like support. RL without prior scaffold supervision struggles to learn stable reasoning from sparse answer rewards alone. The combination works best, matching the paper’s broader argument about the complementary roles of SFT and RL.

The provided full-text excerpt does not expose every benchmark-level number or all ablation magnitudes, but the experimental logic is clear: sustained gains over iterative rounds, better stability than synthetic-only evolution, and a meaningful benefit from the SFT-then-RL decomposition.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the method overview figure and the section on Failing-Frontier Discovery. The key question is whether the paper is truly doing targeted training or just relabeling hard-example mining. Then read Truth Anchor Expansion carefully. Focus on where anchors come from, how retrieval is conditioned on failures, and how anchors are turned into new supervision. That is the part that determines whether the framework is genuinely more reliable than synthetic self-evolution.

After that, read the scaffold-stripping section together with its ablations. The main thing to verify is what RL is actually contributing: better reasoning, better template removal, or both. If the paper includes case studies, inspect examples where a failed trajectory is diagnosed, linked to an anchor, and reconstructed into a training sample. Those examples are often more revealing than aggregate scores.

The most useful figures and tables are the iterative performance curves, anchor vs. no-anchor comparisons, and scaffold/RL ablations. For deeper follow-up, three questions matter: how dependent the method is on database coverage, how much teacher bias still enters through failure diagnosis and hints, and whether the same recipe could transfer to text-only reasoning continual training.

recommendation.zh: 后训练里少见地把“失败前沿定位 + 真值锚定”讲成了可执行 recipe；先看数据构造部分，若 setup 干净，值得迁到 reasoning data pipeline 里试。
recommendation.en: One of the few post-training papers that turns 'failure-frontier mining + ground-truth anchoring' into an actionable recipe; read the data-construction part first and port it if the setup is clean.

paper.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
paper.abstract: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. We argue the skill should instead be trained as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible. SkillOpt is, to our knowledge, the first systematic controllable text-space optimize

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是：在不改模型权重的情况下，如何把 agent 的“技能文档”从一次性提示词变成可训练、可验证、可迁移的外部适配层。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 与 agent 适配接口有启发。它把自然语言技能视为外部状态，用类似训练循环的方式做优化：采样轨迹、分析误差、限制更新幅度、用 held-out split 验证、保留失败更新作为负反馈。这类方法说明，部分“程序性能力”可以不进入权重，而以可审计文本状态承载。对闭源模型、工具型 agent、长期任务 harness 来说，这是一种成本较低的适配路径。它也提醒预训练研究：模型能力不只由参数决定，外部可学习上下文和执行协议会显著改变可观测能力。
summary.technical_approach: SkillOpt 的核心是一个文本空间优化器。给定目标模型、任务域、执行 harness 和初始 skill，它反复运行目标模型收集 trajectory batch，再让一个更强的 frontier optimizer model 分析成功与失败案例，并提出结构化编辑，包括 add、delete、replace。论文把更新幅度显式做成“textual learning rate”，限制每轮 skill 相对上一版本的移动距离，避免一次重写破坏已有有效策略。候选 skill 会在 selection split 上评估，只有通过验证门控才被接受；被拒绝的编辑不会丢弃，而是进入 rejected-step buffer，作为后续优化器调用的负反馈。epoch 级 slow/meta update 类似动量，用于保留跨轮次稳定出现的修改方向，但最终导出的仍是一个较短的 best_skill.md。与 TextGrad、GEPA 这类 prompt optimization 相比，它更强调训练式控制变量：batch 证据、更新步长、验证门控、失败历史和慢更新；与 EvoSkill、Trace2Skill 相比，它不是只把经验蒸馏成技能，而是把技能编辑本身组织成可控优化过程。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 个 benchmark：SearchQA、SpreadsheetBench、OfficeQA、DocVQA、LiveMathematicianBench、ALFWorld；7 个目标模型；3 种执行模式，包括 direct chat、Codex harness 和 Claude Code harness。论文报告在 52 个 model-benchmark-harness 组合中，SkillOpt 都是最好或并列最好。以 GPT-5.5 direct chat 为例，SearchQA 从 77.7 提升到 87.3，SpreadsheetBench 从 41.8 到 80.7，OfficeQA 从 33.1 到 72.1，DocVQA 从 78.8 到 91.2，LiveMathematicianBench 从 37.6 到 66.9，ALFWorld 从 83.6 到 95.5，平均相对 no-skill 提升 23.5 分。相比每个设置下最强 baseline，包括 human-written skill、one-shot LLM skill、Trace2Skill、TextGrad、GEPA、EvoSkill，平均提升 5.4 分。在 Codex-style 和 Claude Code-style 执行中，GPT-5.5 相对 no-skill 分别提升 24.8 和 19.1 分；相对 EvoSkill 分别提升 14.0 和 3.2 分。迁移实验显示，SpreadsheetBench 上用 GPT-5.4 训练的 skill 能提升更小 GPT 变体；Codex 上训练的 spreadsheet skill 迁移到 Claude Code 有 59.7 分收益；OlympiadBench skill 对 Omni-MATH 也有正迁移。消融显示，受限文本步长优于不受控重写，held-out gate 能阻止坏更新积累，rejected-step buffer 提供有效负反馈，slow/meta update 有助于长程细化且不会让部署 skill 过长。最终 skill 通常只有 300 到 2000 token，接受编辑次数为 1 到 4 次。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 到 35 分钟。优先看 Method 中 skill 状态、rollout batch、reflection minibatch、textual learning rate、selection gate、rejected buffer 和 slow/meta update 的定义；这些是论文真正的机制部分。实验部分重点看 52 个组合的主表、相对 baseline 的 per-cell 对比，以及消融表。迁移实验值得快速看，因为它决定 skill 是否只是 benchmark overfit，还是能作为可复用 procedural artifact。案例分析可选读，主要用于判断学到的是流程约束、工具策略和错误规避，还是样例记忆。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to turn an agent skill document into a trainable external adaptation layer, rather than treating it as a one-off prompt or manually written instruction.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a base-model pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. It shows that a non-parametric textual state can be optimized with training-like controls: trajectory batches, bounded update size, validation gating, negative feedback from rejected edits, and slow accumulated updates. This matters for closed models and tool-using agents, where weight updates are often unavailable. It also sharpens an important point for foundation-model research: observed agent capability is partly determined by learnable external procedures, not only by model weights.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillOpt treats the skill file as the optimization state. At each step, the frozen target model runs a batch of tasks with the current skill. A separate frontier optimizer model inspects successful and failed trajectories and proposes structured add, delete, and replace edits. These edits are aggregated and ranked under a textual learning-rate budget, so a new skill version cannot move too far from the previous one. Candidate skills are evaluated on a held-out selection split before acceptance. Rejected edits are retained as negative feedback for later optimizer calls, and an epoch-level slow or meta update carries stable editing directions across steps. The exported artifact is a compact best_skill.md file, while the target model and execution harness remain fixed. Compared with generic prompt optimization such as TextGrad or GEPA, the method adds explicit controls over evidence quality, update magnitude, validation, rejected updates, and long-horizon refinement. Compared with skill distillation or evolution methods, it frames skill editing itself as a controlled domain-adaptation loop.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans six benchmarks: SearchQA, SpreadsheetBench, OfficeQA, DocVQA, LiveMathematicianBench, and ALFWorld; seven target models; and three execution modes, including direct chat, a Codex-style harness, and a Claude Code-style harness. Across 52 evaluated model-benchmark-harness cells, SkillOpt is reported as best or tied-best in every cell. With GPT-5.5 in direct chat, it improves SearchQA from 77.7 to 87.3, SpreadsheetBench from 41.8 to 80.7, OfficeQA from 33.1 to 72.1, DocVQA from 78.8 to 91.2, LiveMathematicianBench from 37.6 to 66.9, and ALFWorld from 83.6 to 95.5, for an average gain of 23.5 points over no skill. It also beats the strongest per-cell baseline among human-written skills, one-shot LLM skills, Trace2Skill, TextGrad, GEPA, and EvoSkill by 5.4 points on average. In Codex-style and Claude Code-style loops, GPT-5.5 gains 24.8 and 19.1 points over no skill, and 14.0 and 3.2 points over EvoSkill. Transfer results are also reported: a SpreadsheetBench skill trained on GPT-5.4 improves smaller GPT variants, a Codex-trained spreadsheet skill transfers to Claude Code with a 59.7-point gain, and an OlympiadBench skill transfers positively to Omni-MATH. Ablations support the main design choices: bounded textual updates beat uncontrolled rewriting, held-out gating blocks harmful edits, rejected-step memory provides useful negative evidence, and slow/meta updates help long-horizon refinement without bloating the deployed skill.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus first on the method definitions: skill state, rollout batches, reflection minibatches, textual learning rate, selection gating, rejected-edit buffers, and slow/meta updates. Then read the main 52-cell result table, the strongest-baseline comparison, and the ablation table. The transfer section is worth reading because it tests whether the learned skill is merely benchmark-specific or reusable across models and harnesses. The case studies are optional but help inspect whether the method learns procedural rules, tool policies, and failure avoidance rather than memorized examples.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和验证集接受准则；它像 prompt 优化的坐标下降，干净度取决于 held-out 是否真隔离。
recommendation.en: Read the optimizer setup and validation gate; it is prompt-space coordinate descent, and the signal is only as clean as the held-out split.
